================================================================================
FILE: Export-Project-Code.ps1
================================================================================


# Export project source code into one text document
# Run this script from your project root folder.

$root = (Get-Location).Path
$output = Join-Path $root "Project-Source-Code.txt"

$extensions = @(
    ".js", ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx",
    ".css", ".scss", ".html",
    ".json", ".md", ".mdx",
    ".yaml", ".yml", ".xml",
    ".sql", ".prisma", ".ps1",
    ".mjs", ".cjs", ".txt"
)

$excludedDirs = @(
    "node_modules", ".next", ".git",
    "dist", "build", "coverage",
    ".vercel"
)

$files = Get-ChildItem -Path $root -Recurse -File |
    Where-Object {
        $relative = $_.FullName.Substring($root.Length).
            TrimStart([char[]]"\/")
        $parts = $relative -split '[/\\]'

        ($extensions -contains $_.Extension.ToLower()) -and
        ($parts | Where-Object { $excludedDirs -contains $_ }).Count -eq 0 -and
        ($_.Name -notlike ".env*") -and
        ($_.Name -notmatch "lock$") -and
        ($_.Name -notmatch "service.?account|credentials|secrets?" )
    } |
    Sort-Object FullName

$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$writer = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter(
    $output, $false, $utf8
)

try {
    foreach ($file in $files) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($root.Length).
            TrimStart([char[]]"\/")

        $writer.WriteLine("")
        $writer.WriteLine("=" * 80)
        $writer.WriteLine("FILE: $relativePath")
        $writer.WriteLine("=" * 80)
        $writer.WriteLine("")

        try {
            $content = Get-Content -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Raw
            $writer.WriteLine($content)
        }
        catch {
            $writer.WriteLine("[Could not read this file]")
        }
    }
}
finally {
    $writer.Close()
}

Write-Host "Export complete!"
Write-Host "Files included: $($files.Count)"
Write-Host "Output: $output"

const { createHash } = require("node:crypto");
const { getApps, initializeApp } = require("firebase-admin/app");
const { getFirestore, FieldValue, Timestamp } = require("firebase-admin/firestore");
const { getMessaging } = require("firebase-admin/messaging");
const { onDocumentCreated } = require("firebase-functions/v2/firestore");
const { onSchedule } = require("firebase-functions/v2/scheduler");
const { getRecurrenceDates } = require("./schedule-recurrence");

const app = getApps()[0] || initializeApp();
const db = getFirestore(app, "default");
const messaging = getMessaging(app);

function notificationId(...parts) {
  return createHash("sha256").update(parts.join(":")).digest("hex");
}

async function createNotification(uid, id, type, title, body, data = {}) {
  const userRef = db.collection("users").doc(uid);
  const user = await userRef.get();
  if (!user.exists) return;
  const preferences = user.data().notificationPreferences || {};
  if (type === "schedule-reminder" && preferences.scheduleReminders === false) return;
  if (type !== "schedule-reminder" && preferences.groupActivity === false) return;

  const notificationRef = db.collection("notifications").doc(id);
  await db.runTransaction(async (transaction) => {
    const existing = await transaction.get(notificationRef);
    if (existing.exists) return;
    transaction.create(notificationRef, {
      uid,
      type,
      title,
      body,
      ...data,
      createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      readAt: null
    });
  });
}

exports.deliverNotification = onDocumentCreated(
  { document: "notifications/{notificationId}", database: "default" },
  async (event) => {
    const notification = event.data.data();
    const tokens = await db.collection("deviceTokens").where("uid", "==", notification.uid).get();
    if (tokens.empty) return;

    const records = tokens.docs;
    const response = await messaging.sendEachForMulticast({
      tokens: records.map((record) => record.data().token),
      webpush: {
        notification: {
          title: notification.title,
          body: notification.body,
          icon: "/icons/prayer-line.svg",
          tag: event.params.notificationId,
          data: {
            url: notification.type === "schedule-reminder" || notification.type === "schedule-invitation"
              ? "/schedule"
              : "/prayer"
          }
        }
      }
    });

    const deletes = [];
    response.responses.forEach((result, index) => {
      if (!result.success && [
        "messaging/invalid-registration-token",
        "messaging/registration-token-not-registered"
      ].includes(result.error?.code)) {
        deletes.push(records[index].ref.delete());
      }
    });
    await Promise.all(deletes);
  }
);

exports.notifyScheduleInvitation = onDocumentCreated(
  {
    document: "prayerSchedules/{scheduleId}/invitations/{uid}",
    database: "default"
  },
  async (event) => {
    const invitation = event.data.data();
    if (invitation.status !== "pending") return;
    await createNotification(
      event.params.uid,
      notificationId("invitation", event.params.scheduleId, event.params.uid),
      "schedule-invitation",
      "Prayer session invitation",
      "You have been invited to a prayer session.",
      { scheduleId: event.params.scheduleId }
    );
  }
);

exports.notifyIncomingPrayerCall = onDocumentCreated(
  { document: "callSessions/{callId}", database: "default" },
  async (event) => {
    const call = event.data.data();
    if (call.status !== "ringing" || !call.calleeUid) return;
    await createNotification(
      call.calleeUid,
      notificationId("call", event.params.callId, call.calleeUid),
      "call-invitation",
      "Incoming prayer call",
      `${call.callerName || "A prayer group member"} is calling you.`,
      { callId: event.params.callId }
    );
  }
);

exports.notifyGroupMessage = onDocumentCreated(
  {
    document: "prayerGroups/{groupId}/messages/{messageId}",
    database: "default"
  },
  async (event) => {
    const message = event.data.data();
    const members = await db.collection("prayerGroups")
      .doc(event.params.groupId)
      .collection("members")
      .get();

    await Promise.all(members.docs
      .filter((member) => member.id !== message.uid)
      .map((member) => createNotification(
        member.id,
        notificationId("message", event.params.groupId, event.params.messageId, member.id),
        "group-activity",
        "Prayer group update",
        "A member shared a new message in your prayer group.",
        { groupId: event.params.groupId }
      )));
  }
);

exports.sendPrayerSessionReminders = onSchedule(
  { schedule: "every 5 minutes", timeZone: "UTC", retryCount: 3 },
  async () => {
    const now = Date.now();
    const windowEndMs = now + 15 * 60 * 1000;
    const scheduleQuery = db.collection("prayerSchedules")
      .where("cancelled", "==", false)
      .where("startsAt", ">=", Timestamp.fromMillis(now - 6 * 365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000))
      .where("startsAt", "<=", Timestamp.fromMillis(windowEndMs))
      .orderBy("startsAt");
    let lastSchedule = null;

    while (true) {
      let pageQuery = scheduleQuery.limit(100);
      if (lastSchedule) pageQuery = pageQuery.startAfter(lastSchedule);
      const schedules = await pageQuery.get();
      if (schedules.empty) return;
      lastSchedule = schedules.docs[schedules.docs.length - 1];

      await Promise.all(schedules.docs.map(async (schedule) => {
        const session = schedule.data();
        let occurrences;
        try {
          occurrences = getRecurrenceDates(
            session.startsAt.toDate(),
            session.recurrence,
            session.timeZone
          ).filter((occurrence) => {
            const occurrenceTime = occurrence.getTime();
            return occurrenceTime >= now && occurrenceTime <= windowEndMs;
          });
        } catch (error) {
          if (!(error instanceof RangeError)) throw error;
          console.error(`Skipping prayer-session reminders for ${schedule.id}: invalid time zone.`, error);
          return;
        }
        if (occurrences.length === 0) return;

        const recipients = new Set([session.creatorUid]);
        if (session.groupId) {
          const members = await db.collection("prayerGroups")
            .doc(session.groupId)
            .collection("members")
            .get();
          members.docs.forEach((member) => recipients.add(member.id));
        } else {
          const accepted = await schedule.ref.collection("invitations")
            .where("status", "==", "accepted")
            .get();
          accepted.docs.forEach((invitation) => recipients.add(invitation.id));
        }

        await Promise.all(occurrences.flatMap((occurrence) =>
          [...recipients].map((uid) => createNotification(
            uid,
            notificationId("reminder", schedule.id, occurrence.toISOString(), uid),
            "schedule-reminder",
            "Prayer session reminder",
            "A prayer session is starting soon.",
            {
              scheduleId: schedule.id,
              occurrenceAt: Timestamp.fromDate(occurrence)
            }
          ))
        ));
      }));

      if (schedules.size < 100) return;
    }
  }
);


================================================================================
FILE: functions\src\schedule-recurrence.js
================================================================================

function getRecurrenceDates(startDate, recurrence, timeZone) {
  if (
    !recurrence ||
    !["daily", "weekly", "monthly"].includes(recurrence.frequency) ||
    !Number.isInteger(recurrence.count) ||
    recurrence.count < 2 ||
    recurrence.count > 52
  ) {
    return [new Date(startDate)];
  }

  const start = getZonedParts(new Date(startDate), timeZone);
  return Array.from({ length: recurrence.count }, (_, index) => {
    if (index === 0) return new Date(startDate);
    const calendarDate = getOccurrenceDate(
      start,
      recurrence.frequency,
      recurrence.interval || 1,
      index
    );
    return zonedDateToUtc({
      ...calendarDate,
      hour: start.hour,
      minute: start.minute,
      second: start.second
    }, timeZone);
  });
}

function getOccurrenceDate(start, frequency, interval, index) {
  if (frequency === "monthly") {
    const monthIndex = start.month - 1 + index * interval;
    const year = start.year + Math.floor(monthIndex / 12);
    const month = (monthIndex % 12) + 1;
    const lastDay = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).getUTCDate();
    return { year, month, day: Math.min(start.day, lastDay) };
  }

  const dayOffset = index * interval * (frequency === "weekly" ? 7 : 1);
  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(start.year, start.month - 1, start.day + dayOffset));
  return {
    year: date.getUTCFullYear(),
    month: date.getUTCMonth() + 1,
    day: date.getUTCDate()
  };
}

function getZonedParts(date, timeZone) {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
    timeZone,
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    second: "2-digit",
    hourCycle: "h23"
  }).formatToParts(date);
  return Object.fromEntries(parts.map((part) => [part.type, Number(part.value)]));
}

function zonedDateToUtc(target, timeZone) {
  const targetTime = Date.UTC(
    target.year,
    target.month - 1,
    target.day,
    target.hour,
    target.minute,
    target.second
  );
  let candidate = targetTime;
  let previous = null;

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 6; attempt += 1) {
    const actual = getZonedParts(new Date(candidate), timeZone);
    const actualTime = Date.UTC(
      actual.year,
      actual.month - 1,
      actual.day,
      actual.hour,
      actual.minute,
      actual.second
    );
    const adjusted = candidate + targetTime - actualTime;
    if (adjusted === candidate) return new Date(candidate);
    if (adjusted === previous) return new Date(Math.max(candidate, adjusted));
    previous = candidate;
    candidate = adjusted;
  }
  return new Date(candidate);
}

exports.getRecurrenceDates = getRecurrenceDates;

const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const test = require("node:test");
const { getRecurrenceDates } = require("./schedule-recurrence");

function localParts(date, timeZone) {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
      timeZone,
      year: "numeric",
      month: "2-digit",
      day: "2-digit",
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
      hourCycle: "h23"
    })
      .formatToParts(date)
      .map((part) => [part.type, part.value])
  );
}

test("function reminders preserve weekly local time across daylight-saving changes", () => {
  const dates = getRecurrenceDates(
    new Date("2027-03-07T14:00:00.000Z"),
    { frequency: "weekly", interval: 1, count: 3 },
    "America/New_York"
  );
  assert.deepEqual(dates.map((date) => localParts(date, "America/New_York").hour), ["09", "09", "09"]);
});

test("function reminders clamp monthly recurrences to the last day of shorter months", () => {
  const dates = getRecurrenceDates(
    new Date("2027-01-31T09:00:00.000Z"),
    { frequency: "monthly", interval: 1, count: 3 },
    "UTC"
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    dates.map((date) => `${date.getUTCFullYear()}-${date.getUTCMonth() + 1}-${date.getUTCDate()}`),
    ["2027-1-31", "2027-2-28", "2027-3-31"]
  );
});

test("function reminders move skipped spring-forward times to the next valid local time", () => {
  const dates = getRecurrenceDates(
    new Date("2027-02-14T07:30:00.000Z"),
    { frequency: "monthly", interval: 1, count: 2 },
    "America/New_York"
  );
  const march = localParts(dates[1], "America/New_York");
  assert.equal(march.month, "03");
  assert.equal(march.day, "14");
  assert.equal(march.hour, "03");
  assert.equal(march.minute, "30");
});

================================================================================
FILE: Export-Project-Code.ps1
================================================================================


# Export project source code into one text document
# Run this script from your project root folder.

$root = (Get-Location).Path
$output = Join-Path $root "Project-Source-Code.txt"

$extensions = @(
    ".js", ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx",
    ".css", ".scss", ".html",
    ".json", ".md", ".mdx",
    ".yaml", ".yml", ".xml",
    ".sql", ".prisma", ".ps1",
    ".mjs", ".cjs", ".txt"
)

$excludedDirs = @(
    "node_modules", ".next", ".git",
    "dist", "build", "coverage",
    ".vercel"
)

$files = Get-ChildItem -Path $root -Recurse -File |
    Where-Object {
        $relative = $_.FullName.Substring($root.Length).
            TrimStart([char[]]"\/")
        $parts = $relative -split '[/\\]'

        ($extensions -contains $_.Extension.ToLower()) -and
        ($parts | Where-Object { $excludedDirs -contains $_ }).Count -eq 0 -and
        ($_.Name -notlike ".env*") -and
        ($_.Name -notmatch "lock$") -and
        ($_.Name -notmatch "service.?account|credentials|secrets?" )
    } |
    Sort-Object FullName

$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$writer = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter(
    $output, $false, $utf8
)

try {
    foreach ($file in $files) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($root.Length).
            TrimStart([char[]]"\/")

        $writer.WriteLine("")
        $writer.WriteLine("=" * 80)
        $writer.WriteLine("FILE: $relativePath")
        $writer.WriteLine("=" * 80)
        $writer.WriteLine("")

        try {
            $content = Get-Content -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Raw
            $writer.WriteLine($content)
        }
        catch {
            $writer.WriteLine("[Could not read this file]")
        }
    }
}
finally {
    $writer.Close()
}

Write-Host "Export complete!"
Write-Host "Files included: $($files.Count)"
Write-Host "Output: $output"

const { createHash } = require("node:crypto");
const { getApps, initializeApp } = require("firebase-admin/app");
const { getFirestore, FieldValue, Timestamp } = require("firebase-admin/firestore");
const { getMessaging } = require("firebase-admin/messaging");
const { onDocumentCreated } = require("firebase-functions/v2/firestore");
const { onSchedule } = require("firebase-functions/v2/scheduler");
const { getRecurrenceDates } = require("./schedule-recurrence");

const app = getApps()[0] || initializeApp();
const db = getFirestore(app, "default");
const messaging = getMessaging(app);

function notificationId(...parts) {
  return createHash("sha256").update(parts.join(":")).digest("hex");
}

async function createNotification(uid, id, type, title, body, data = {}) {
  const userRef = db.collection("users").doc(uid);
  const user = await userRef.get();
  if (!user.exists) return;
  const preferences = user.data().notificationPreferences || {};
  if (type === "schedule-reminder" && preferences.scheduleReminders === false) return;
  if (type !== "schedule-reminder" && preferences.groupActivity === false) return;

  const notificationRef = db.collection("notifications").doc(id);
  await db.runTransaction(async (transaction) => {
    const existing = await transaction.get(notificationRef);
    if (existing.exists) return;
    transaction.create(notificationRef, {
      uid,
      type,
      title,
      body,
      ...data,
      createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      readAt: null
    });
  });
}

exports.deliverNotification = onDocumentCreated(
  { document: "notifications/{notificationId}", database: "default" },
  async (event) => {
    const notification = event.data.data();
    const tokens = await db.collection("deviceTokens").where("uid", "==", notification.uid).get();
    if (tokens.empty) return;

    const records = tokens.docs;
    const response = await messaging.sendEachForMulticast({
      tokens: records.map((record) => record.data().token),
      webpush: {
        notification: {
          title: notification.title,
          body: notification.body,
          icon: "/icons/prayer-line.svg",
          tag: event.params.notificationId,
          data: {
            url: notification.type === "schedule-reminder" || notification.type === "schedule-invitation"
              ? "/schedule"
              : "/prayer"
          }
        }
      }
    });

    const deletes = [];
    response.responses.forEach((result, index) => {
      if (!result.success && [
        "messaging/invalid-registration-token",
        "messaging/registration-token-not-registered"
      ].includes(result.error?.code)) {
        deletes.push(records[index].ref.delete());
      }
    });
    await Promise.all(deletes);
  }
);

exports.notifyScheduleInvitation = onDocumentCreated(
  {
    document: "prayerSchedules/{scheduleId}/invitations/{uid}",
    database: "default"
  },
  async (event) => {
    const invitation = event.data.data();
    if (invitation.status !== "pending") return;
    await createNotification(
      event.params.uid,
      notificationId("invitation", event.params.scheduleId, event.params.uid),
      "schedule-invitation",
      "Prayer session invitation",
      "You have been invited to a prayer session.",
      { scheduleId: event.params.scheduleId }
    );
  }
);

exports.notifyIncomingPrayerCall = onDocumentCreated(
  { document: "callSessions/{callId}", database: "default" },
  async (event) => {
    const call = event.data.data();
    if (call.status !== "ringing" || !call.calleeUid) return;
    await createNotification(
      call.calleeUid,
      notificationId("call", event.params.callId, call.calleeUid),
      "call-invitation",
      "Incoming prayer call",
      `${call.callerName || "A prayer group member"} is calling you.`,
      { callId: event.params.callId }
    );
  }
);

exports.notifyGroupMessage = onDocumentCreated(
  {
    document: "prayerGroups/{groupId}/messages/{messageId}",
    database: "default"
  },
  async (event) => {
    const message = event.data.data();
    const members = await db.collection("prayerGroups")
      .doc(event.params.groupId)
      .collection("members")
      .get();

    await Promise.all(members.docs
      .filter((member) => member.id !== message.uid)
      .map((member) => createNotification(
        member.id,
        notificationId("message", event.params.groupId, event.params.messageId, member.id),
        "group-activity",
        "Prayer group update",
        "A member shared a new message in your prayer group.",
        { groupId: event.params.groupId }
      )));
  }
);

exports.sendPrayerSessionReminders = onSchedule(
  { schedule: "every 5 minutes", timeZone: "UTC", retryCount: 3 },
  async () => {
    const now = Date.now();
    const windowEndMs = now + 15 * 60 * 1000;
    const scheduleQuery = db.collection("prayerSchedules")
      .where("cancelled", "==", false)
      .where("startsAt", ">=", Timestamp.fromMillis(now - 6 * 365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000))
      .where("startsAt", "<=", Timestamp.fromMillis(windowEndMs))
      .orderBy("startsAt");
    let lastSchedule = null;

    while (true) {
      let pageQuery = scheduleQuery.limit(100);
      if (lastSchedule) pageQuery = pageQuery.startAfter(lastSchedule);
      const schedules = await pageQuery.get();
      if (schedules.empty) return;
      lastSchedule = schedules.docs[schedules.docs.length - 1];

      await Promise.all(schedules.docs.map(async (schedule) => {
        const session = schedule.data();
        let occurrences;
        try {
          occurrences = getRecurrenceDates(
            session.startsAt.toDate(),
            session.recurrence,
            session.timeZone
          ).filter((occurrence) => {
            const occurrenceTime = occurrence.getTime();
            return occurrenceTime >= now && occurrenceTime <= windowEndMs;
          });
        } catch (error) {
          if (!(error instanceof RangeError)) throw error;
          console.error(`Skipping prayer-session reminders for ${schedule.id}: invalid time zone.`, error);
          return;
        }
        if (occurrences.length === 0) return;

        const recipients = new Set([session.creatorUid]);
        if (session.groupId) {
          const members = await db.collection("prayerGroups")
            .doc(session.groupId)
            .collection("members")
            .get();
          members.docs.forEach((member) => recipients.add(member.id));
        } else {
          const accepted = await schedule.ref.collection("invitations")
            .where("status", "==", "accepted")
            .get();
          accepted.docs.forEach((invitation) => recipients.add(invitation.id));
        }

        await Promise.all(occurrences.flatMap((occurrence) =>
          [...recipients].map((uid) => createNotification(
            uid,
            notificationId("reminder", schedule.id, occurrence.toISOString(), uid),
            "schedule-reminder",
            "Prayer session reminder",
            "A prayer session is starting soon.",
            {
              scheduleId: schedule.id,
              occurrenceAt: Timestamp.fromDate(occurrence)
            }
          ))
        ));
      }));

      if (schedules.size < 100) return;
    }
  }
);

FILE: functions\src\schedule-recurrence.js
================================================================================

function getRecurrenceDates(startDate, recurrence, timeZone) {
  if (
    !recurrence ||
    !["daily", "weekly", "monthly"].includes(recurrence.frequency) ||
    !Number.isInteger(recurrence.count) ||
    recurrence.count < 2 ||
    recurrence.count > 52
  ) {
    return [new Date(startDate)];
  }

  const start = getZonedParts(new Date(startDate), timeZone);
  return Array.from({ length: recurrence.count }, (_, index) => {
    if (index === 0) return new Date(startDate);
    const calendarDate = getOccurrenceDate(
      start,
      recurrence.frequency,
      recurrence.interval || 1,
      index
    );
    return zonedDateToUtc({
      ...calendarDate,
      hour: start.hour,
      minute: start.minute,
      second: start.second
    }, timeZone);
  });
}

function getOccurrenceDate(start, frequency, interval, index) {
  if (frequency === "monthly") {
    const monthIndex = start.month - 1 + index * interval;
    const year = start.year + Math.floor(monthIndex / 12);
    const month = (monthIndex % 12) + 1;
    const lastDay = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).getUTCDate();
    return { year, month, day: Math.min(start.day, lastDay) };
  }

  const dayOffset = index * interval * (frequency === "weekly" ? 7 : 1);
  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(start.year, start.month - 1, start.day + dayOffset));
  return {
    year: date.getUTCFullYear(),
    month: date.getUTCMonth() + 1,
    day: date.getUTCDate()
  };
}

function getZonedParts(date, timeZone) {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
    timeZone,
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    second: "2-digit",
    hourCycle: "h23"
  }).formatToParts(date);
  return Object.fromEntries(parts.map((part) => [part.type, Number(part.value)]));
}

function zonedDateToUtc(target, timeZone) {
  const targetTime = Date.UTC(
    target.year,
    target.month - 1,
    target.day,
    target.hour,
    target.minute,
    target.second
  );
  let candidate = targetTime;
  let previous = null;

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 6; attempt += 1) {
    const actual = getZonedParts(new Date(candidate), timeZone);
    const actualTime = Date.UTC(
      actual.year,
      actual.month - 1,
      actual.day,
      actual.hour,
      actual.minute,
      actual.second
    );
    const adjusted = candidate + targetTime - actualTime;
    if (adjusted === candidate) return new Date(candidate);
    if (adjusted === previous) return new Date(Math.max(candidate, adjusted));
    previous = candidate;
    candidate = adjusted;
  }
  return new Date(candidate);
}

exports.getRecurrenceDates = getRecurrenceDates;

const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
const test = require("node:test");
const { getRecurrenceDates } = require("./schedule-recurrence");

function localParts(date, timeZone) {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
      timeZone,
      year: "numeric",
      month: "2-digit",
      day: "2-digit",
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
      hourCycle: "h23"
    })
      .formatToParts(date)
      .map((part) => [part.type, part.value])
  );
}

test("function reminders preserve weekly local time across daylight-saving changes", () => {
  const dates = getRecurrenceDates(
    new Date("2027-03-07T14:00:00.000Z"),
    { frequency: "weekly", interval: 1, count: 3 },
    "America/New_York"
  );
  assert.deepEqual(dates.map((date) => localParts(date, "America/New_York").hour), ["09", "09", "09"]);
});

test("function reminders clamp monthly recurrences to the last day of shorter months", () => {
  const dates = getRecurrenceDates(
    new Date("2027-01-31T09:00:00.000Z"),
    { frequency: "monthly", interval: 1, count: 3 },
    "UTC"
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    dates.map((date) => `${date.getUTCFullYear()}-${date.getUTCMonth() + 1}-${date.getUTCDate()}`),
    ["2027-1-31", "2027-2-28", "2027-3-31"]
  );
});

test("function reminders move skipped spring-forward times to the next valid local time", () => {
  const dates = getRecurrenceDates(
    new Date("2027-02-14T07:30:00.000Z"),
    { frequency: "monthly", interval: 1, count: 2 },
    "America/New_York"
  );
  const march = localParts(dates[1], "America/New_York");
  assert.equal(march.month, "03");
  assert.equal(march.day, "14");
  assert.equal(march.hour, "03");
  assert.equal(march.minute, "30");
});

================================================================================
FILE: public\firebase-messaging-sw.js
================================================================================

importScripts("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.10.0/firebase-app-compat.js");
importScripts("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.10.0/firebase-messaging-compat.js");

let messagingInitialization;

function initializeMessaging() {
  if (!messagingInitialization) {
    messagingInitialization = fetch("/api/firebase/public-config")
      .then(async (response) => {
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Firebase web-push configuration is unavailable.");
        firebase.initializeApp(await response.json());
        const messaging = firebase.messaging();
        messaging.onBackgroundMessage((payload) => {
          const notification = payload.notification || {};
          self.registration.showNotification(notification.title || "My Prayer Line", {
            body: notification.body || "You have a new community update.",
            icon: notification.icon || "/icons/prayer-line.svg",
            tag: notification.tag,
            data: notification.data || {}
          });
        });
      });
  }
  return messagingInitialization;
}

self.addEventListener("install", (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(initializeMessaging().catch((error) => {
    console.error("Unable to initialize background notifications.", error);
  }));
});

self.addEventListener("notificationclick", (event) => {
  event.notification.close();
  const destination = event.notification.data?.url || "/prayer";
  event.waitUntil(self.clients.matchAll({ type: "window", includeUncontrolled: true }).then((clients) => {
    const existing = clients.find((client) => new URL(client.url).origin === self.location.origin);
    if (existing) {
      existing.navigate(destination);
      return existing.focus();
    }
    return self.clients.openWindow(destination);
  }));
});

FILE: README.md

# My Prayer Line

My Prayer Line is a JavaScript/Next.js App Router application with Firebase-backed authentication and workspaces for prayer groups, schedules, the Heat Room, and profile settings.

The Firebase project currently connected to this workspace is `my-prayer-line-20261016`.

## Local setup

1. Install Node.js 22 (the app also requires Node.js 20.9 or newer).
2. Install app dependencies with `npm install`.
3. Copy `.env.local.example` to `.env.local` beside `package.json`. Fill in the six Firebase client values from **Firebase Console â†’ Project settings â†’ Your apps**. Keep each variable on its own line.
4. In **Firebase Console â†’ Authentication â†’ Sign-in method**, enable Email/Password. Add local and production hostnames under **Authorized domains** so verification and password-reset emails can return to the app.
5. Create a Cloud Firestore database with ID `default` in your chosen region.
6. Configure Firebase Admin credentials for the server using one of:
   - Application Default Credentials in a trusted Google Cloud runtime, with `FIREBASE_ADMIN_PROJECT_ID`; or
   - `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` pointing to a service-account JSON key kept outside source control; or
   - `FIREBASE_ADMIN_PROJECT_ID`, `FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL`, and `FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY` from a service account, stored in the deployment secret store.

   The Admin identity needs Firebase Authentication user-management permissions and Firestore read/write access for session creation, invitations, moderation, and account deletion. If profile avatars are enabled, it also needs permission to delete objects from the configured Storage bucket. Do not use a `NEXT_PUBLIC_` prefix for Admin credentials.
7. Enable Firebase Storage if avatar uploads are needed.
8. Deploy Firestore rules and indexes with `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes`. Deploy Storage rules after enabling Storage with `firebase deploy --only storage`.
9. Start the app with `npm run dev`.

The Admin SDK accepts `NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` as a project ID fallback. A service-account private key stored in an environment variable should retain escaped `\n` line breaks; the server initializer converts them.

This project targets Firestore database ID `default` (not Firestore's `(default)` database). The client initializer, Admin initializer, Functions, and `firebase.json` must use the same ID.

## Implemented features

- **Prayer groups:** Discover and search public groups, create groups, join or leave, manage membership as a group administrator, and exchange member-only real-time messages in a dedicated chat workspace. Chat loads the latest 40 messages and paginates older history on demand. Group administrators can permanently delete a group and its messages, memberships, schedules, calls, and related notifications.
- **Schedules:** Create, edit, and cancel sessions; share them with a joined group or invite selected members of a group to a private session. Invitees can accept or decline and RSVP. Recurrence supports daily, weekly, or monthly sessions (up to 52 occurrences) while preserving local wall time across daylight-saving changes. Times are stored as UTC timestamps alongside an IANA time-zone identifier.
- **Prayer calls:** Start private one-to-one audio or video internet calls from a group chat. Calls use Wi-Fi or mobile data, not carrier minutes. Firestore rules protect session signaling; audio/video media travels directly between browsers over WebRTC.
- **Heat Room:** Publish prayer requests and testimonies to the community, a joined group, or yourself; post requests anonymously; acknowledge prayer, react to testimonies, reply, and report a post. Audience checks are enforced by Firestore rules. Anonymous author IDs are stored separately in an owner-only moderation document.
- **Profile:** Update display name, phone number, biography, avatar, verified email, password, notification preferences, and the default audience for new posts. Avatars are limited to JPEG, PNG, or WebP files up to 5 MB.
- **Account deletion:** Requires typing `DELETE` and reauthentication within five minutes. Private/profile data, authored group messages, comments, and reports are removed; shared prayer requests and testimonies are retained with the author anonymized; group ownership is transferred to the earliest remaining member when possible; owned group sessions are transferred and cancelled, or deleted with an empty group; private sessions are deleted.
- **Moderation:** Users can report posts. A moderator review page is available to accounts with the Firebase Auth custom claim `moderator: true`.
- **Notifications:** The app includes a notification inbox, browser push enrollment, Cloud Functions source for group, schedule-invitation, and incoming-call notifications, plus a scheduled reminder processor. Reminders account for future occurrences in recurring schedules and preserve the selected time zone. Notification text does not include prayer content.

The main Firestore collections include `users`, `prayerGroups` (with `members` and `messages`), `prayerSchedules` (with `attendance` and private `invitations`), `callSessions` (with ICE `signals`), `prayerRequests`, `testimonies`, `reports`, `notifications`, and `deviceTokens`. Group membership/count changes use Firestore transactions.

## Optional Firebase services

### Web push and App Check

To enable browser push:

1. In **Firebase Console â†’ Project settings â†’ Cloud Messaging**, configure Web Push certificates and copy the VAPID public key to `NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_VAPID_KEY`.
2. Add the app's public Firebase configuration to `.env.local`; the service worker reads it from `/api/firebase/public-config`.
3. Use a supported browser on HTTPS (or localhost), allow notification permission, and enroll each device from Profile.

App Check is optional. Register the web app with reCAPTCHA v3 in **Firebase Console â†’ App Check**, set `NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_SITE_KEY`, and add the application domains in reCAPTCHA. Before enforcing App Check in Firebase, verify every client surface that accesses protected Firebase services is initialized with App Check.

### Cloud Functions

Functions are in `functions/` and target Node.js 22. Install their dependencies and deploy them with:

```sh
npm install --prefix functions
firebase deploy --only functions
```

Scheduled reminders require the Firebase/Google Cloud project to have billing enabled and the Cloud Scheduler/Functions APIs available. Configure billing and required APIs in the Firebase/Google Cloud consoles before deploying. For the currently connected project, billing is disabled and the Cloud Functions, Cloud Scheduler, Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Artifact Registry, and Eventarc APIs are disabled; the current Firebase CLI identity also cannot enable APIs. Notification and reminder delivery is not active until Functions have been deployed successfully.

### Moderator access

From an environment with trusted Application Default Credentials and the Admin project ID configured, grant a moderator claim with:

```sh
node scripts/grant-moderator.mjs <firebase-auth-uid>
```

The moderator must sign in again for the updated custom claim to appear in their ID token. Only grant this claim to trusted accounts.

## Call setup notes

Calls start from the audio/video controls in a group chat and use public STUN servers for direct peer-to-peer connectivity. Some restrictive networks require a TURN relay, which is not configured; test on the intended networks and set up a trusted TURN provider before relying on calls for all users. Peer-to-peer calls expose network IP addresses to the other participant. Calls are limited to members of a shared prayer group.

## Remaining setup

- Email notifications are not integrated with an email delivery provider.
- Browser calling has not been exercised with cameras and microphones on real devices. Avatar upload, push delivery, and App Check enforcement also depend on additional Firebase project configuration and have not been end-to-end validated. The moderator review API was integration-tested with temporary accounts; production moderator provisioning still requires granting the custom claim to trusted users.

## Verification

Run `npm test`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run build`. Deploy the current Firestore rules and indexes before using the Firestore-backed features. The schedule invitation collection-group query depends on the recursive invitations read rule in `firestore.rules`.

FILE: scripts\grant-moderator.mjs
================================================================================

import { applicationDefault, initializeApp } from "firebase-admin/app";
import { getAuth } from "firebase-admin/auth";

const uid = process.argv[2];
const projectId = process.env.FIREBASE_ADMIN_PROJECT_ID || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID;

if (!uid || !projectId) {
  console.error("Usage: node scripts/grant-moderator.mjs <firebase-auth-uid>");
  console.error("Set FIREBASE_ADMIN_PROJECT_ID and configure Application Default Credentials.");
  process.exit(1);
}

const app = initializeApp({ credential: applicationDefault(), projectId });
const auth = getAuth(app);
const user = await auth.getUser(uid);
await auth.setCustomUserClaims(uid, { ...user.customClaims, moderator: true });
console.log(`Moderator access granted to ${user.email || uid}. The user must sign in again for the claim to take effect.`);

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { getSessionUser } from "@/lib/auth";
import DashboardShell from "@/components/layout/DashboardShell";

export default async function DashboardLayout({ children }) {
  const user = await getSessionUser();

  if (!user) {
    redirect("/login");
  }

  return <DashboardShell email={user.email} isModerator={user.moderator === true}>{children}</DashboardShell>;
}

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { getSessionUser } from "@/lib/auth";
import ModerationWorkspace from "@/features/moderation/ModerationWorkspace";

export default async function ModerationPage() {
  const user = await getSessionUser();
  if (!user?.moderator) redirect("/prayer");
  return <ModerationWorkspace />;
}

FILE: src\app\api\auth\delete-account\route.js

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { FieldValue } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
import {
  getFirebaseAdminAuth,
  getFirebaseAdminDb,
  getFirebaseAdminStorage
} from "@/lib/firebase-admin";
import { SESSION_COOKIE_NAME } from "@/lib/auth";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

const RECENT_AUTH_WINDOW_SECONDS = 5 * 60;
const COLLECTIONS_WITH_UID = ["attendance", "invitations", "messages", "prayingUsers", "reactions", "comments", "moderation"];

function isSameOrigin(request) {
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  const host =
    request.headers.get("x-forwarded-host")?.split(",")[0].trim() ||
    request.headers.get("host");
  const protocol =
    request.headers.get("x-forwarded-proto")?.split(",")[0].trim() ||
    new URL(request.url).protocol.slice(0, -1);

  if (!origin || !host) return false;

  try {
    const originUrl = new URL(origin);
    return originUrl.host.toLowerCase() === host.toLowerCase() &&
      originUrl.protocol === `${protocol}:`;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

async function deleteQuery(query) {
  const snapshot = await query.get();
  await Promise.all(snapshot.docs.map((document) => document.ref.delete()));
}

async function deleteUserSubcollections(db, uid) {
  for (const collectionName of COLLECTIONS_WITH_UID) {
    await deleteQuery(db.collectionGroup(collectionName).where("uid", "==", uid));
  }

  await deleteQuery(db.collection("reports").where("reporterUid", "==", uid));
  await deleteQuery(db.collection("deviceTokens").where("uid", "==", uid));
  await deleteQuery(db.collection("notifications").where("uid", "==", uid));
  const calls = await db.collection("callSessions").where("participantUids", "array-contains", uid).get();
  await Promise.all(calls.docs.map((call) => db.recursiveDelete(call.ref)));
}

async function transferGroups(db, uid) {
  const memberships = await db.collectionGroup("members").where("uid", "==", uid).get();
  const ownedGroups = new Map();

  for (const membership of memberships.docs) {
    const groupRef = membership.ref.parent.parent;
    if (groupRef) ownedGroups.set(groupRef.path, { groupRef, membership });
  }

  const transfers = new Map();
  for (const { groupRef, membership } of ownedGroups.values()) {
    const group = await groupRef.get();
    if (!group.exists || group.data().creatorUid !== uid) continue;

    const members = await groupRef.collection("members").orderBy("joinedAt", "asc").get();
    const successor = members.docs.find((member) => member.id !== uid);
    if (!successor) {
      const schedules = await db.collection("prayerSchedules").where("groupId", "==", groupRef.id).get();
      await Promise.all(schedules.docs.map((schedule) => db.recursiveDelete(schedule.ref)));
      await db.recursiveDelete(groupRef);
      transfers.set(groupRef.id, null);
      continue;
    }

    const successorName = successor.data().displayName || "Group administrator";
    await db.runTransaction(async (transaction) => {
      transaction.update(groupRef, {
        creatorUid: successor.id,
        creatorName: successorName,
        memberCount: Math.max(1, (group.data().memberCount || members.size) - 1),
        updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      });
      transaction.update(successor.ref, { role: "admin" });
    });
    transfers.set(groupRef.id, successor.id);
  }

  for (const { membership } of ownedGroups.values()) {
    const groupRef = membership.ref.parent.parent;
    if (groupRef && !transfers.has(groupRef.id)) {
      await groupRef.update({
        memberCount: FieldValue.increment(-1),
        updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      });
    }
    await membership.ref.delete();
  }
  return transfers;
}

async function deleteOwnedSchedules(db, uid, transfers) {
  const schedules = await db.collection("prayerSchedules").where("creatorUid", "==", uid).get();
  for (const schedule of schedules.docs) {
    const groupId = schedule.data().groupId;
    const successorUid = groupId ? transfers.get(groupId) : null;

    if (successorUid) {
      await schedule.ref.update({
        creatorUid: successorUid,
        cancelled: true,
        updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      });
    } else {
      await db.recursiveDelete(schedule.ref);
    }
  }
}

async function anonymizeSharedPosts(db, collectionName, uid) {
  const posts = await db.collection(collectionName).where("authorUid", "==", uid).get();
  for (const post of posts.docs) {
    await post.ref.update({
      authorUid: FieldValue.delete(),
      authorName: "Former community member",
      authorPhotoURL: null,
      updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
    });
  }
}

export async function DELETE(request) {
  if (!isSameOrigin(request)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request origin." }, { status: 403 });
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "A valid confirmation is required." }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (body?.confirmation !== "DELETE") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Type DELETE to confirm account removal." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const sessionCookie = cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value;
  if (!sessionCookie) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Sign in again to delete your account." }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const auth = getFirebaseAdminAuth();
    const user = await auth.verifySessionCookie(sessionCookie, true);
    const authAge = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) - user.auth_time;
    if (authAge < 0 || authAge > RECENT_AUTH_WINDOW_SECONDS) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "For your security, re-enter your password before deleting your account." },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    const db = getFirebaseAdminDb();
    const transfers = await transferGroups(db, user.uid);
    await deleteOwnedSchedules(db, user.uid, transfers);
    await Promise.all([
      anonymizeSharedPosts(db, "prayerRequests", user.uid),
      anonymizeSharedPosts(db, "testimonies", user.uid)
    ]);
    await deleteUserSubcollections(db, user.uid);

    const bucketName = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET;
    if (bucketName) {
      const bucket = getFirebaseAdminStorage().bucket(bucketName);
      const [bucketExists] = await bucket.exists();
      if (bucketExists) {
        await bucket.deleteFiles({ prefix: `users/${user.uid}/`, force: true });
      }
    }

    await db.recursiveDelete(db.collection("users").doc(user.uid));
    await auth.deleteUser(user.uid);

    const response = NextResponse.json({ deleted: true });
    response.cookies.set(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, "", {
      httpOnly: true,
      maxAge: 0,
      path: "/",
      sameSite: "lax",
      secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production"
    });
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    if (["auth/argument-error", "auth/id-token-revoked", "auth/session-cookie-expired", "auth/session-cookie-revoked", "auth/user-disabled", "auth/user-not-found"].includes(error.code)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Your session expired. Sign in again and retry." }, { status: 401 });
    }
    console.error("Unable to complete account deletion.", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "We couldn't finish deleting your account. Contact support before retrying." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\auth\session\route.js

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getFirebaseAdminAuth } from "@/lib/firebase-admin";
import { SESSION_COOKIE_NAME } from "@/lib/auth";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

const SESSION_DURATION_MS = 5 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const AUTH_ERROR_CODES = new Set([
  "auth/argument-error",
  "auth/id-token-expired",
  "auth/id-token-revoked",
  "auth/invalid-id-token",
  "auth/user-not-found",
  "auth/user-disabled"
]);

function isSameOrigin(request) {
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  const forwardedHost = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-host")?.split(",")[0].trim();
  const forwardedProtocol = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-proto")?.split(",")[0].trim();
  const host = forwardedHost || request.headers.get("host");

  if (!origin || !host) {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const originUrl = new URL(origin);
    const requestProtocol = forwardedProtocol || new URL(request.url).protocol.slice(0, -1);

    return (
      (requestProtocol === "http" || requestProtocol === "https") &&
      originUrl.protocol === `${requestProtocol}:` &&
      originUrl.host.toLowerCase() === host.toLowerCase()
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function sessionCookieOptions() {
  return {
    httpOnly: true,
    maxAge: SESSION_DURATION_MS / 1000,
    path: "/",
    sameSite: "lax",
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production"
  };
}

export async function POST(request) {
  if (!isSameOrigin(request)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request origin." }, { status: 403 });
  }

  let body;

  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "A valid JSON body is required." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (
    !body ||
    typeof body !== "object" ||
    typeof body.idToken !== "string" ||
    body.idToken.length === 0 ||
    body.idToken.length > 10000
  ) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "A valid Firebase ID token is required." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const decodedToken = await getFirebaseAdminAuth().verifyIdToken(body.idToken, true);

    if (decodedToken.email_verified !== true) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Verify your email address before signing in." },
        { status: 403 }
      );
    }

    const sessionCookie = await getFirebaseAdminAuth().createSessionCookie(body.idToken, {
      expiresIn: SESSION_DURATION_MS
    });
    const response = NextResponse.json({ authenticated: true });

    response.cookies.set(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, sessionCookie, sessionCookieOptions());
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    if (AUTH_ERROR_CODES.has(error.code)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in again." },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    console.error("Unable to create the Firebase session.", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          process.env.NODE_ENV === "production"
            ? "Unable to create a secure session. Check the Firebase Admin credentials configured for this deployment."
            : error.message || "Unable to create a secure session."
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function DELETE(request) {
  if (!isSameOrigin(request)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request origin." }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const response = NextResponse.json({ authenticated: false });
  response.cookies.set(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, "", {
    ...sessionCookieOptions(),
    maxAge: 0
  });
  return response;
}

    headers: { "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=3600, stale-while-revalidate=86400" }
  });
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { FieldValue } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
import { getFirebaseAdminAuth, getFirebaseAdminDb } from "@/lib/firebase-admin";
import { SESSION_COOKIE_NAME } from "@/lib/auth";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

function isSameOrigin(request) {
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  const host =
    request.headers.get("x-forwarded-host")?.split(",")[0].trim() ||
    request.headers.get("host");
  const protocol =
    request.headers.get("x-forwarded-proto")?.split(",")[0].trim() ||
    new URL(request.url).protocol.slice(0, -1);
  if (!origin || !host) return false;

  try {
    const originUrl = new URL(origin);
    return originUrl.host.toLowerCase() === host.toLowerCase() &&
      originUrl.protocol === `${protocol}:`;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

async function getModerator() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const session = cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value;
  if (!session) return null;

  const decoded = await getFirebaseAdminAuth().verifySessionCookie(session, true);
  return decoded.moderator === true ? decoded : null;
}

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const moderator = await getModerator();
    if (!moderator) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Moderator access is required." }, { status: 403 });

    const db = getFirebaseAdminDb();
    const snapshot = await db.collection("reports")
      .orderBy("createdAt", "desc")
      .limit(100)
      .get();
    const reports = await Promise.all(snapshot.docs.map(async (report) => {
      const data = report.data();
      const post = await db.collection(data.contentType).doc(data.contentId).get();
      return {
        id: report.id,
        ...data,
        content: post.exists ? {
          text: post.data().text || "",
          authorName: post.data().anonymous ? "Anonymous community member" : post.data().authorName || "Community member",
          status: post.data().status
        } : null
      };
    }));
    return NextResponse.json({ reports });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Unable to load moderation reports.", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unable to load reports." }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function PATCH(request) {
  if (!isSameOrigin(request)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request origin." }, { status: 403 });
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "A valid moderation action is required." }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (typeof body?.reportId !== "string" || !["remove", "dismiss"].includes(body.action)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Choose a valid report and moderation action." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const moderator = await getModerator();
    if (!moderator) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Moderator access is required." }, { status: 403 });

    const db = getFirebaseAdminDb();
    const reportRef = db.collection("reports").doc(body.reportId);
    const report = await reportRef.get();
    if (!report.exists) return NextResponse.json({ error: "This report no longer exists." }, { status: 404 });

    const data = report.data();
    if (!["prayerRequests", "testimonies"].includes(data.contentType) || typeof data.contentId !== "string") {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "This report contains invalid content references." }, { status: 400 });
    }
    if (body.action === "remove") {
      const postRef = db.collection(data.contentType).doc(data.contentId);
      const post = await postRef.get();
      if (post.exists) {
        await postRef.update({
          status: "deleted",
          text: "",
          updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
        });
        if (post.data().anonymous) {
          await db.recursiveDelete(postRef.collection("moderation"));
        }
      }
    }

    await reportRef.update({
      reviewStatus: body.action === "remove" ? "removed" : "dismissed",
      reviewedBy: moderator.uid,
      reviewedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
    });
    return NextResponse.json({ reviewed: true });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Unable to process a moderation action.", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unable to complete this moderation action." }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { getFirebaseAdminAuth, getFirebaseAdminDb } from "@/lib/firebase-admin";
import { SESSION_COOKIE_NAME } from "@/lib/auth";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

function isSameOrigin(request) {
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  const host =
    request.headers.get("x-forwarded-host")?.split(",")[0].trim() ||
    request.headers.get("host");
  const protocol =
    request.headers.get("x-forwarded-proto")?.split(",")[0].trim() ||
    new URL(request.url).protocol.slice(0, -1);

  if (!origin || !host) return false;
  try {
    const originUrl = new URL(origin);
    return originUrl.host.toLowerCase() === host.toLowerCase() &&
      originUrl.protocol === `${protocol}:`;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function DELETE(request, { params }) {
  if (!isSameOrigin(request)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request origin." }, { status: 403 });
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Type the group name to confirm deletion." }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (typeof body?.confirmation !== "string" || body.confirmation.length > 80) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Type the group name to confirm deletion." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const sessionCookie = (await cookies()).get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value;
    if (!sessionCookie) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Sign in again to delete this group." }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const user = await getFirebaseAdminAuth().verifySessionCookie(sessionCookie, true);
    const db = getFirebaseAdminDb();
    const { groupId } = await params;
    const groupRef = db.collection("prayerGroups").doc(groupId);
    const [group, membership] = await Promise.all([
      groupRef.get(),
      groupRef.collection("members").doc(user.uid).get()
    ]);

    if (!group.exists) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "This prayer group no longer exists." }, { status: 404 });
    }
    if (
      group.data().creatorUid !== user.uid ||
      !membership.exists ||
      membership.data().role !== "admin"
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Only this group's administrator can delete it." }, { status: 403 });
    }
    if (body.confirmation !== group.data().name) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "The group name did not match." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const [schedules, calls] = await Promise.all([
      db.collection("prayerSchedules").where("groupId", "==", groupId).get(),
      db.collection("callSessions").where("groupId", "==", groupId).get()
    ]);
    const relatedNotifications = await Promise.all([
      ...schedules.docs.map((schedule) =>
        db.collection("notifications").where("scheduleId", "==", schedule.id).get()
      ),
      ...calls.docs.map((call) =>
        db.collection("notifications").where("callId", "==", call.id).get()
      )
    ]);
    const notificationRefs = new Map(
      relatedNotifications.flatMap((snapshot) =>
        snapshot.docs.map((notification) => [notification.ref.path, notification.ref])
      )
    );
    await Promise.all([
      ...schedules.docs.map((schedule) => db.recursiveDelete(schedule.ref)),
      ...calls.docs.map((call) => db.recursiveDelete(call.ref)),
      ...[...notificationRefs.values()].map((notificationRef) => notificationRef.delete())
    ]);
    await db.recursiveDelete(groupRef);

    return NextResponse.json({ deleted: true });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code?.startsWith("auth/")) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Your session expired. Sign in again and retry." }, { status: 401 });
    }
    console.error("Unable to delete prayer group.", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Unable to delete this group and its related content. Please retry." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\schedules\[scheduleId]\invitations\route.js

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { FieldValue } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
import { getFirebaseAdminAuth, getFirebaseAdminDb } from "@/lib/firebase-admin";
import { SESSION_COOKIE_NAME } from "@/lib/auth";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

function isSameOrigin(request) {
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  const host =
    request.headers.get("x-forwarded-host")?.split(",")[0].trim() ||
    request.headers.get("host");
  const protocol =
    request.headers.get("x-forwarded-proto")?.split(",")[0].trim() ||
    new URL(request.url).protocol.slice(0, -1);
  if (!origin || !host) return false;
  try {
    const originUrl = new URL(origin);
    return originUrl.host.toLowerCase() === host.toLowerCase() &&
      originUrl.protocol === `${protocol}:`;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function POST(request, { params }) {
  if (!isSameOrigin(request)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request origin." }, { status: 403 });
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "A valid invitation request is required." }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (
    typeof body?.sourceGroupId !== "string" ||
    !Array.isArray(body?.uids) ||
    body.uids.length < 1 ||
    body.uids.length > 200 ||
    body.uids.some((uid) => typeof uid !== "string" || uid.length > 128) ||
    new Set(body.uids).size !== body.uids.length
  ) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Select between 1 and 200 unique group members to invite." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const session = (await cookies()).get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value;
    if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Sign in again to invite group members." }, { status: 401 });
    const user = await getFirebaseAdminAuth().verifySessionCookie(session, true);
    const db = getFirebaseAdminDb();
    const scheduleRef = db.collection("prayerSchedules").doc((await params).scheduleId);
    const [schedule, ownMembership] = await Promise.all([
      scheduleRef.get(),
      db.collection("prayerGroups").doc(body.sourceGroupId).collection("members").doc(user.uid).get()
    ]);

    if (!schedule.exists || schedule.data().creatorUid !== user.uid || schedule.data().groupId !== null) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Only the creator of a private session can invite guests." }, { status: 403 });
    }
    if (!ownMembership.exists) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "You must belong to the selected group to invite its members." }, { status: 403 });
    }
    if (body.uids.includes(user.uid)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "You cannot invite yourself." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const memberRefs = body.uids.map((uid) =>
      db.collection("prayerGroups").doc(body.sourceGroupId).collection("members").doc(uid)
    );
    const memberSnapshots = await db.getAll(...memberRefs);
    if (memberSnapshots.some((member) => !member.exists)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Every invitee must still belong to the selected group." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const batch = db.batch();
    body.uids.forEach((uid) => {
      batch.set(scheduleRef.collection("invitations").doc(uid), {
        uid,
        sourceGroupId: body.sourceGroupId,
        invitedBy: user.uid,
        status: "pending",
        createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      }, { merge: false });
    });
    await batch.commit();
    return NextResponse.json({ invitationsSent: body.uids.length });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code?.startsWith("auth/")) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Your session expired. Sign in again and retry." }, { status: 401 });
    }
    console.error("Unable to invite schedule participants.", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unable to send these prayer-session invitations." }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

@import "tailwindcss";

"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { initializeAppCheck, ReCaptchaV3Provider } from "firebase/app-check";
import { app } from "@/lib/firebase";

let initialized = false;

export default function FirebaseAppCheck() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const siteKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_SITE_KEY;
    if (!siteKey || initialized) return;

    initializeAppCheck(app, {
      provider: new ReCaptchaV3Provider(siteKey),
      isTokenAutoRefreshEnabled: true
    });
    initialized = true;
  }, []);

  return null;
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  createUserWithEmailAndPassword,
  sendEmailVerification,
  sendPasswordResetEmail,
  signInWithEmailAndPassword,
  signOut,
  updateProfile
} from "firebase/auth";
import { doc, runTransaction, serverTimestamp } from "firebase/firestore";
import { getFirebaseAuth, getFirebaseDb } from "@/lib/firebase";

const COPY = {
  login: {
    title: "Welcome back",
    description: "Sign in to continue to your prayer community.",
    submit: "Sign in",
    footer: "New to My Prayer Line?",
    footerLink: "Create an account",
    footerHref: "/register"
  },
  register: {
    title: "Create your account",
    description: "Join a community that makes space for prayer.",
    submit: "Create account",
    footer: "Already have an account?",
    footerLink: "Sign in",
    footerHref: "/login"
  },
  reset: {
    title: "Reset your password",
    description: "Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.",
    submit: "Send reset link",
    footer: "Remembered your password?",
    footerLink: "Sign in",
    footerHref: "/login"
  }
};

function getErrorMessage(error) {
  const messages = {
    "auth/api-key-not-valid":
      "Firebase rejected the web API key. Replace NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY in .env.local with the exact apiKey from Firebase Console â†’ Project settings â†’ General â†’ Your apps. If the key is correct, check its API restrictions and allow Identity Toolkit API.",
    "auth/email-already-in-use": "An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.",
    "auth/invalid-credential": "The email or password is incorrect.",
    "auth/invalid-email": "Enter a valid email address.",
    "auth/network-request-failed": "Network error. Check your connection and try again.",
    "auth/too-many-requests": "Too many attempts. Please wait a little and try again.",
    "auth/weak-password": "Choose a stronger password with at least 8 characters.",
    "auth/user-disabled": "This account has been disabled. Contact support for help.",
    "auth/user-not-found": "The email or password is incorrect.",
    "auth/wrong-password": "The email or password is incorrect."
  };

  if (messages[error.code]) {
    return messages[error.code];
  }

  return error.message || "Something went wrong. Please try again.";
}

async function createSession(idToken) {
  const response = await fetch("/api/auth/session", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ idToken })
  });
  const responseBody = await response.text();
  let result = null;

  if (responseBody.trim()) {
    try {
      result = JSON.parse(responseBody);
    } catch {
      throw new Error(
        `The sign-in service returned an unexpected response (HTTP ${response.status}). ` +
          "Check the Vercel deployment and function logs."
      );
    }
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      result?.error ||
        `Unable to create a secure session (HTTP ${response.status}). ` +
          "Check the Firebase Admin environment variables and Vercel function logs."
    );
  }

  if (result?.authenticated !== true) {
    throw new Error(
      `The sign-in service returned an empty response (HTTP ${response.status}). ` +
        "Check the Vercel deployment and function logs."
    );
  }
}

async function saveUserProfile(user) {
  const db = getFirebaseDb();
  const profileRef = doc(db, "users", user.uid);
  const profile = {
    uid: user.uid,
    email: user.email,
    displayName: user.displayName || user.email?.split("@")[0] || "Member",
    photoURL: user.photoURL
  };

  await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
    const existingProfile = await transaction.get(profileRef);
    const updatedProfile = {
      ...profile,
      updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
    };

    if (existingProfile.exists()) {
      transaction.update(profileRef, updatedProfile);
      return;
    }

    transaction.set(profileRef, {
      ...updatedProfile,
      createdAt: serverTimestamp()
    });
  });
}

export default function AuthForm({ mode }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const copy = COPY[mode];

  async function handleSubmit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setNotice("");

    const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (mode === "register" && password !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("Your passwords do not match.");
      return;
    }

    if (mode === "register" && displayName.trim().length === 0) {
      setError("Enter your name to create an account.");
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const auth = getFirebaseAuth();

      if (mode === "register") {
        const credential = await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, normalizedEmail, password);

        try {
          await updateProfile(credential.user, { displayName: displayName.trim() });
          await saveUserProfile(credential.user);
          await sendEmailVerification(credential.user, {
            url: `${window.location.origin}/login`
          });
        } finally {
          await signOut(auth);
        }

        setNotice("Account created. Check your email to verify your address, then sign in.");
        setPassword("");
        setConfirmPassword("");
        return;
      }

      if (mode === "reset") {
        try {
          await sendPasswordResetEmail(auth, normalizedEmail);
        } catch (resetError) {
          if (resetError.code !== "auth/user-not-found") {
            throw resetError;
          }
        }
        setNotice("If an account exists for that email, a password reset link is on its way.");
        return;
      }

      const credential = await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, normalizedEmail, password);

      if (!credential.user.emailVerified) {
        try {
          await sendEmailVerification(credential.user, {
            url: `${window.location.origin}/login`
          });
        } finally {
          await signOut(auth);
        }
        setNotice("Please verify your email before signing in. We sent you a new verification link.");
        return;
      }

      await saveUserProfile(credential.user);
      try {
        await createSession(await credential.user.getIdToken());
      } catch (sessionError) {
        await signOut(auth);
        throw sessionError;
      }
      router.replace("/prayer");
    } catch (submitError) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(submitError));
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="auth-layout">
      <aside className="auth-story">
        <Link href="/" className="mb-12 inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-3 text-sm font-bold tracking-tight text-teal-950">
          <span className="brand-mark grid h-11 w-11 place-items-center rounded-2xl text-white">
            <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" className="h-5 w-5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8">

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { getFirebaseAuth } from "@/lib/firebase";
import DashboardNavigation from "@/components/navigation/DashboardNavigation";
import DashboardNotifications from "@/components/navigation/DashboardNotifications";
import { useCurrentUser } from "@/hooks/useCurrentUser";

export default function DashboardShell({ email, isModerator = false, children }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { user } = useCurrentUser();
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [isSigningOut, setIsSigningOut] = useState(false);

  async function handleSignOut() {
    setError("");
    setIsSigningOut(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/auth/session", { method: "DELETE" });
      const result = await response.json();
      await getFirebaseAuth().signOut();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          result.error || "Your local session ended, but the server session could not be cleared."
        );
      }

      router.replace("/login");
    } catch (signOutError) {
      setError(signOutError.message || "Unable to sign out completely. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setIsSigningOut(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="dashboard-backdrop min-h-screen text-slate-900">
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-20 border-b border-white/70 bg-white/85 shadow-[0_4px_24px_-20px_rgba(22,50,37,0.4)] backdrop-blur-xl">
        <div className="mx-auto flex h-[4.5rem] max-w-[1440px] items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-8">
          <Link href="/prayer" className="flex items-center gap-3" aria-label="My Prayer Line home">
            <span className="brand-mark grid h-10 w-10 place-items-center rounded-2xl text-sm font-bold text-white">
              <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" className="h-5 w-5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M12 3v18M5 8.5h14M5 15.5h14" />
              </svg>
            </span>
            <span>
              <span className="block text-sm font-bold tracking-tight text-teal-950">
                My Prayer Line
              </span>
              <span className="hidden text-xs text-slate-500 sm:block">A place to pray together</span>
            </span>
          </Link>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 sm:gap-5">
            <DashboardNotifications />
            <div
              title={user?.displayName || email}
              className="flex max-w-[10rem] items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-white/75 py-1 pl-1 pr-3 sm:max-w-56"
            >
              {user?.photoURL ? (
                // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                <img src={user.photoURL} alt="" className="h-8 w-8 rounded-full object-cover" />
              ) : (
                <span className="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-teal-100 text-xs font-bold text-teal-900">
                  {(user?.displayName || email || "M").slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}
                </span>
              )}
              <span className="truncate text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 sm:text-sm">
                {user?.displayName || email}
              </span>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleSignOut}
              disabled={isSigningOut}
              className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white/80 px-3.5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-white disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {isSigningOut ? "Signing outâ€¦" : "Sign out"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
        {error && (
          <p role="alert" className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 pb-3 text-sm text-red-700 sm:px-8">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
      </header>

      <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-[1440px] grid-cols-1 gap-7 px-4 py-6 pb-24 sm:px-8 lg:grid-cols-[228px_minmax(0,1fr)] lg:gap-9 lg:py-9 lg:pb-12">
        <aside className="hidden lg:block">
          <div className="sticky top-24">
