"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";

const ITEMS = [
  { href: "/prayer", label: "Prayer", icon: "prayer" },
  { href: "/schedule", label: "Schedule", icon: "schedule" },
  { href: "/heat-room", label: "Heat Room", icon: "community" },
  { href: "/profile", label: "Profile", icon: "profile" }
];

function NavigationIcon({ name }) {
  const paths = {
    prayer: <><path d="M12 21v-8" /><path d="M12 13c-4.4 0-7-2.5-7-6 4.5 0 7 2.2 7 6Z" /><path d="M12 11c0-4 2.8-6.5 7-6.5 0 3.7-2.5 6.5-7 6.5Z" /></>,
    schedule: <><rect x="3.5" y="5" width="17" height="16" rx="2.5" /><path d="M7.5 3v4M16.5 3v4M3.5 9.5h17M8 13h.01M12 13h.01M16 13h.01M8 17h.01M12 17h.01" /></>,
    community: <><path d="M16 20v-1.5a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H7a4 4 0 0 0-4 4V20" /><circle cx="9.5" cy="7" r="3.5" /><path d="M17 11a3.5 3.5 0 1 0-1.2-6.8M21 20v-1.5a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.9" /></>,
    profile: <><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4" /><path d="M4 21a8 8 0 0 1 16 0" /></>,
    moderation: <><path d="M12 3 20 6v5c0 5-3.4 8.6-8 10-4.6-1.4-8-5-8-10V6l8-3Z" /><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4" /></>
  };
  return (
    <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" className="h-[18px] w-[18px]" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
      {paths[name]}
    </svg>
  );
}

export default function DashboardNavigation({ mobile = false, isModerator = false }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const items = isModerator
    ? [...ITEMS, { href: "/moderation", label: "Moderation", icon: "moderation" }]
    : ITEMS;
  const mobileColumns = items.length > 5 ? "grid-cols-6" : items.length === 5 ? "grid-cols-5" : "grid-cols-4";

  return (
    <nav aria-label="Main navigation" className={mobile ? `grid ${mobileColumns} gap-1` : "space-y-1"}>
      {items.map((item) => {
        const active = pathname === item.href || pathname.startsWith(`${item.href}/`);

        return (
          <Link
            key={item.href}
            href={item.href}
            aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
            className={`dashboard-nav-link flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl px-3 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition ${
              mobile ? "flex-col gap-1 px-1 py-2 text-xs" : ""
            } ${
              active
                ? "nav-active"
                : "text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-950"
            }`}
          >
            <span
              aria-hidden="true"
              className={`dashboard-nav-icon grid h-9 w-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl ${
                active ? "bg-teal-800 text-white" : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600"
              }`}
            >
              <NavigationIcon name={item.icon} />
            </span>
            {item.label}
          </Link>
        );
      })}
    </nav>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\navigation\DashboardNotifications.jsx

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import {
  collection,
  doc,
  limit,
  onSnapshot,
  orderBy,
  query,
  serverTimestamp,
  updateDoc,
  where
} from "firebase/firestore";
import { useCurrentUser } from "@/hooks/useCurrentUser";
import { getFirebaseDb } from "@/lib/firebase";

const db = getFirebaseDb();

function getDestination(notification) {
  if (notification.type === "call-invitation") return "/calls";
  if (notification.type === "schedule-reminder" || notification.type === "schedule-invitation") {
    return "/schedule";
  }
  return "/prayer";
}

export default function DashboardNotifications() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { user } = useCurrentUser();
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState([]);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return undefined;
    return onSnapshot(
      query(
        collection(db, "notifications"),
        where("uid", "==", user.uid),
        orderBy("createdAt", "desc"),
        limit(8)
      ),
      (snapshot) => {
        setNotifications(snapshot.docs.map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() })));
        setError("");
      },
      (snapshotError) => setError(snapshotError.message || "Notifications could not be loaded.")
    );
  }, [user]);

  async function openNotification(notification) {
    setError("");
    try {
      if (!notification.readAt) {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, "notifications", notification.id), { readAt: serverTimestamp() });
      }
      setOpen(false);
      router.push(getDestination(notification));
    } catch (updateError) {
      setError(updateError.message || "This notification could not be opened.");
    }
  }

  const unreadCount = notifications.filter((notification) => !notification.readAt).length;

  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-label={`Notifications${unreadCount ? `, ${unreadCount} unread` : ""}`}
        onClick={() => setOpen((current) => !current)}
        className="relative grid h-10 w-10 place-items-center rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
      >
        <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" className="h-5 w-5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7">
          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M18 9a6 6 0 0 0-12 0c0 7-3 7-3 9h18c0-2-3-2-3-9M10 21h4" />
        </svg>
        {unreadCount > 0 && (
          <span className="absolute -right-1 -top-1 grid h-5 min-w-5 place-items-center rounded-full bg-red-600 px-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-white">
            {unreadCount > 9 ? "9+" : unreadCount}
          </span>
        )}
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 top-12 z-40 w-[min(90vw,360px)] rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3 shadow-xl">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">Notifications</h2>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} aria-label="Close notifications" className="rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100">Ã—</button>
          </div>
          {error && <p role="alert" className="m-2 rounded-lg bg-red-50 p-2 text-xs text-red-800">{error}</p>}
          {notifications.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="px-2 py-6 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">You&apos;re all caught up.</p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="mt-2 max-h-96 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto">
              {notifications.map((notification) => (
                <li key={notification.id}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => openNotification(notification)}
                    className={`w-full rounded-xl p-3 text-left hover:bg-slate-50 ${notification.readAt ? "" : "bg-teal-50/70"}`}
                  >
                    <span className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">{notification.title || "Community update"}</span>
                      {!notification.readAt && <span aria-label="Unread" className="mt-1 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-teal-700" />}
                    </span>
                    <span className="mt-1 block text-xs leading-5 text-slate-600">{notification.body}</span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function Notice({ children, tone = "error" }) {
  const toneClass =
    tone === "success"
      ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-900"
      : tone === "info"
        ? "border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 text-sky-900"
        : "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-900";

  return (
    <p role="status" className={`rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-6 ${toneClass}`}>
      {children}
    </p>
  );
}

export function EmptyState({ title, description, children }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50/70 px-5 py-9 text-center">
      <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">{title}</h3>
      <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-md text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">{description}</p>
      {children && <div className="mt-4">{children}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function formatDate(date) {
  if (!date) return "Just now";
  const value = typeof date.toDate === "function" ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);
  if (Number.isNaN(value.getTime())) return "Just now";

  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
    dateStyle: "medium",
    timeStyle: "short"
  }).format(value);
}

import { EmptyState, LoadingState, PageHeading, Panel, PrimaryButton, SecondaryButton } from "@/components/ui/DashboardPrimitives";

const db = getFirebaseDb();
const ICE_SERVERS = [{ urls: "stun:stun.l.google.com:19302" }];

function displayName(user) {
  return user.displayName || user.email?.split("@")[0] || "Community member";
}

function getError(error) {
  if (error.name === "NotAllowedError" || error.name === "PermissionDeniedError") {
    return "Allow microphone or camera access in your browser to start the call.";
  }
  if (error.name === "NotFoundError" || error.name === "DevicesNotFoundError") {
    return "No compatible microphone or camera was found on this device.";
  }
  if (error.code === "permission-denied") {
    return "Call access was denied. Make sure you and the person you are calling are still group members.";
  }
  if (error.code === "unavailable") {
    return "The call service is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.";
  }
  return error.message || "The call could not be completed.";
}

async function removeCallSignals(callId) {
  const signals = await getDocs(collection(db, "callSessions", callId, "signals"));
  await Promise.all(signals.docs.map((signal) => deleteDoc(signal.ref)));
}

async function closeCallAfterFailure(callId, ringingStatus) {
  const callRef = doc(db, "callSessions", callId);
  const snapshot = await getDoc(callRef);
  if (!snapshot.exists()) return;
  const status = snapshot.data().status;
  if (status === "ringing" || status === "active") {
    const nextStatus = status === "active" ? "ended" : ringingStatus;
    await updateDoc(callRef, {
      status: nextStatus,
      offer: null,
      answer: null,
      updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
      endedAt: serverTimestamp()
    });
  }
  await removeCallSignals(callId);
}

export default function CallsWorkspace({
  embeddedGroupId = "",
  embeddedCallType = "audio",
  embedded = false,
  onClose,
  onIncomingCall
} = {}) {
  const { user, loading: authLoading } = useCurrentUser();
  const [groups, setGroups] = useState([]);
  const [groupId, setGroupId] = useState(embeddedGroupId);
  const [calleeUid, setCalleeUid] = useState("");
  const [callType, setCallType] = useState(embeddedCallType);
  const [calls, setCalls] = useState([]);
  const [currentCall, setCurrentCall] = useState(null);
  const [localStream, setLocalStream] = useState(null);
  const [remoteStream, setRemoteStream] = useState(null);
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(false);
  const [cameraOff, setCameraOff] = useState(false);
  const [connecting, setConnecting] = useState(false);
  const [connectionState, setConnectionState] = useState("new");
  const [loadingGroups, setLoadingGroups] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [callQueryError, setCallQueryError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const peerRef = useRef(null);
  const localStreamRef = useRef(null);
  const remoteStreamRef = useRef(null);
  const currentCallRef = useRef(currentCall);
  const finishLocalCallRef = useRef(null);
  const pendingCandidatesRef = useRef([]);
  const receivedCandidateIdsRef = useRef(new Set());
  const callQueryErrorsRef = useRef({ caller: "", callee: "" });
  const localVideoRef = useRef(null);
  const remoteVideoRef = useRef(null);
  const remoteAudioRef = useRef(null);
  currentCallRef.current = currentCall;
  finishLocalCallRef.current = finishLocalCall;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return undefined;
    let live = true;
    const stopMemberships = onSnapshot(
      query(collectionGroup(db, "members"), where("uid", "==", user.uid)),
      async (snapshot) => {
        try {
          const memberships = await Promise.all(snapshot.docs.map(async (membership) => {
            const groupRef = membership.ref.parent.parent;
            if (!groupRef) return null;
            const [groupSnapshot, membersSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
              getDoc(groupRef),
              getDocs(collection(db, "prayerGroups", groupRef.id, "members"))
            ]);
            if (!groupSnapshot.exists()) return null;
            return {
              id: groupRef.id,
              name: groupSnapshot.data().name || "Prayer group",
              members: membersSnapshot.docs
                .map((member) => ({ uid: member.id, ...member.data() }))
                .filter((member) => member.uid !== user.uid)
            };
          }));
          if (!live) return;
          const availableGroups = memberships.filter((group) =>
            group && group.members.length && (!embeddedGroupId || group.id === embeddedGroupId)
          );
          setGroups(availableGroups);
          setGroupId((current) =>
            availableGroups.some((group) => group.id === current)
              ? current
              : embeddedGroupId || availableGroups[0]?.id || ""
          );
          setError("");
        } catch (groupError) {
          if (live) setError(getError(groupError));
        } finally {
          if (live) setLoadingGroups(false);
        }
      },
      (snapshotError) => {
        if (live) {
          setError(getError(snapshotError));
          setLoadingGroups(false);
        }
      }
    );
    return () => {
      live = false;
      stopMemberships();
    };
  }, [user, embeddedGroupId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return undefined;
    let callerSessions = [];
    let calleeSessions = [];
    function updateCalls() {
      const byId = new Map([...callerSessions, ...calleeSessions].map((call) => [call.id, call]));
      setCalls([...byId.values()]);
    }
    function setQueryError(source, message) {
      callQueryErrorsRef.current = { ...callQueryErrorsRef.current, [source]: message };
      setCallQueryError(Object.values(callQueryErrorsRef.current).find(Boolean) || "");
    }
    const stopCaller = onSnapshot(
      query(collection(db, "callSessions"), where("callerUid", "==", user.uid), where("status", "in", ["ringing", "active"])),
      (snapshot) => {
        callerSessions = snapshot.docs.map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }));
        setQueryError("caller", "");
        updateCalls();
      },
      (snapshotError) => setQueryError("caller", getError(snapshotError))
    );
    const stopCallee = onSnapshot(
      query(collection(db, "callSessions"), where("calleeUid", "==", user.uid), where("status", "in", ["ringing", "active"])),
      (snapshot) => {
        calleeSessions = snapshot.docs.map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }));
        setQueryError("callee", "");
        updateCalls();
      },
      (snapshotError) => setQueryError("callee", getError(snapshotError))
    );
    return () => {
      stopCaller();
      stopCallee();
    };
  }, [user]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (localVideoRef.current) localVideoRef.current.srcObject = localStream;
    if (currentCall?.callType === "video" && remoteVideoRef.current) {
      remoteVideoRef.current.srcObject = remoteStream;
    }
    if (currentCall?.callType === "audio" && remoteAudioRef.current) {
      remoteAudioRef.current.srcObject = remoteStream;
    }
  }, [currentCall, localStream, remoteStream]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const callState = currentCallRef.current;
    if (!callState || !user) return undefined;
    let live = true;
    const otherUid = callState.callerUid === user.uid ? callState.calleeUid : callState.callerUid;
    const callRef = doc(db, "callSessions", callState.id);
    const stopCall = onSnapshot(
      callRef,
      async (snapshot) => {
        if (!live) return;
        if (!snapshot.exists()) {
          finishLocalCallRef.current?.("The other participant ended the call.");
          return;
        }
        const call = snapshot.data();
        if (call.status === "ended" || call.status === "declined") {
          finishLocalCallRef.current?.(call.status === "declined" ? "The call was declined." : "The call has ended.");
          try {
            await removeCallSignals(callState.id);
          } catch (cleanupError) {
            setError(getError(cleanupError));
          }
          return;
        }
        const peer = peerRef.current;
        if (
          callState.callerUid === user.uid &&
          call.answer?.sdp &&
          peer &&
          !peer.currentRemoteDescription
        ) {
          try {
            await peer.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(call.answer));
            await flushPendingCandidates(peer);
          } catch (descriptionError) {
            if (live) setError(getError(descriptionError));
          }
        }
      },
      (snapshotError) => {
        if (live) setError(getError(snapshotError));
      }
    );
    const stopSignals = onSnapshot(
      query(collection(db, "callSessions", callState.id, "signals"), where("senderUid", "==", otherUid)),
      (snapshot) => {
        const peer = peerRef.current;
        if (!peer) return;
        snapshot.docChanges().forEach((change) => {
          if (change.type === "removed" || receivedCandidateIdsRef.current.has(change.doc.id)) return;
          receivedCandidateIdsRef.current.add(change.doc.id);
          const candidate = new RTCIceCandidate(change.doc.data().candidate);
          if (peer.remoteDescription) {
            peer.addIceCandidate(candidate).catch((candidateError) => {
              if (live) setError(getError(candidateError));
            });
          } else {
            pendingCandidatesRef.current.push(candidate);
          }
        });
      },
      (snapshotError) => {
        if (live) setError(getError(snapshotError));
      }
    );
    return () => {
      live = false;
      stopCall();
      stopSignals();
      disposePeer();
    };
  }, [currentCall?.id, currentCall?.callerUid, currentCall?.calleeUid, user]);

  async function flushPendingCandidates(peer) {
    const candidates = pendingCandidatesRef.current.splice(0);
    await Promise.all(candidates.map((candidate) => peer.addIceCandidate(candidate)));
  }

  function disposePeer() {
    if (peerRef.current) {
      peerRef.current.onicecandidate = null;
      peerRef.current.close();
    }
    peerRef.current = null;
    localStreamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
    localStreamRef.current = null;
    remoteStreamRef.current = null;
    pendingCandidatesRef.current = [];
    receivedCandidateIdsRef.current.clear();
    setLocalStream(null);
    setRemoteStream(null);
    setConnectionState("new");
    setMuted(false);
    setCameraOff(false);
  }

  function finishLocalCall(message) {
    disposePeer();
    setCurrentCall(null);
    setConnecting(false);
    setNotice(message);
  }

  async function startCall(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const selectedGroup = groups.find((group) => group.id === groupId);
    const callee = selectedGroup?.members.find((member) => member.uid === calleeUid);
    if (!user || !selectedGroup || !callee) {
      setError("Choose a prayer-group member to call.");
      return;
    }
    setConnecting(true);
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    let callRef;
    let callCreated = false;
    try {
      if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
        throw new Error("Voice and video calls require a browser with media-device support over HTTPS or localhost.");
      }
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        audio: true,
        video: callType === "video"
      });
      const peer = new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers: ICE_SERVERS });
      const remote = new MediaStream();
      callRef = doc(collection(db, "callSessions"));
      peerRef.current = peer;
      localStreamRef.current = stream;
      remoteStreamRef.current = remote;
      stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => peer.addTrack(track, stream));
      peer.ontrack = (event) => {
        const [incoming] = event.streams;
        if (incoming) incoming.getTracks().forEach((track) => remote.addTrack(track));
        setRemoteStream(remote);
      };
      peer.onconnectionstatechange = () => setConnectionState(peer.connectionState);
      const offer = await peer.createOffer();
      await setDoc(callRef, {
        participantUids: [user.uid, callee.uid],
        callerUid: user.uid,
        callerName: displayName(user),
        calleeUid: callee.uid,
        calleeName: callee.displayName || "Prayer group member",
        groupId: selectedGroup.id,
        callType,
        status: "ringing",
        offer: { type: offer.type, sdp: offer.sdp },
        answer: null,
        createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
        endedAt: null
      });
      callCreated = true;
      peer.onicecandidate = (iceEvent) => {
        if (!iceEvent.candidate) return;
        addDoc(collection(db, "callSessions", callRef.id, "signals"), {
          senderUid: user.uid,
          candidate: iceEvent.candidate.toJSON(),
          createdAt: serverTimestamp()
        }).catch((signalError) => setError(getError(signalError)));
      };
      await peer.setLocalDescription(offer);
      setLocalStream(stream);
      setRemoteStream(remote);
      setCurrentCall({
        id: callRef.id,
        callerUid: user.uid,
        calleeUid: callee.uid,
        callType,
        otherName: callee.displayName || "Prayer group member"
      });
      setNotice("Calling. Keep this page open while the other person answers.");
    } catch (callError) {
      let message = getError(callError);
      if (callRef && callCreated) {
        try {
          await closeCallAfterFailure(callRef.id, "ended");
        } catch (cleanupError) {
          message = `${message} Call cleanup also failed: ${getError(cleanupError)}`;
        }
      }
      disposePeer();
      setError(message);
    } finally {
      setConnecting(false);
    }
  }

  async function acceptCall(call) {
    setConnecting(true);
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
        throw new Error("Voice and video calls require a browser with media-device support over HTTPS or localhost.");
      }
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        audio: true,
        video: call.callType === "video"
      });
      const peer = new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers: ICE_SERVERS });
      const remote = new MediaStream();
      peerRef.current = peer;
      localStreamRef.current = stream;
      remoteStreamRef.current = remote;
      stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => peer.addTrack(track, stream));
      peer.ontrack = (event) => {
        const [incoming] = event.streams;
        if (incoming) incoming.getTracks().forEach((track) => remote.addTrack(track));
        setRemoteStream(remote);
      };
      peer.onconnectionstatechange = () => setConnectionState(peer.connectionState);
      peer.onicecandidate = (iceEvent) => {
        if (!iceEvent.candidate) return;
        addDoc(collection(db, "callSessions", call.id, "signals"), {
          senderUid: user.uid,
          candidate: iceEvent.candidate.toJSON(),
          createdAt: serverTimestamp()
        }).catch((signalError) => setError(getError(signalError)));
      };
      await peer.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(call.offer));
      const answer = await peer.createAnswer();
      await peer.setLocalDescription(answer);
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "callSessions", call.id), {
        status: "active",
        answer: { type: answer.type, sdp: answer.sdp },
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
      await flushPendingCandidates(peer);
      setLocalStream(stream);
      setRemoteStream(remote);
      setCurrentCall({
        id: call.id,
        callerUid: call.callerUid,
        calleeUid: call.calleeUid,
        callType: call.callType,
        otherName: call.callerName || "Prayer group member"
      });
    } catch (callError) {
      disposePeer();
      let message = getError(callError);
      try {
        await closeCallAfterFailure(call.id, "declined");
      } catch (declineError) {
        message = `${message} The invitation could not be closed: ${getError(declineError)}`;
      }
      setError(message);
    } finally {
      setConnecting(false);
    }
  }

  async function declineCall(call) {
    setError("");
    try {
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "callSessions", call.id), {
        status: "declined",
        offer: null,
        answer: null,
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
        endedAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
      await removeCallSignals(call.id);
      setNotice("The call was declined.");
    } catch (declineError) {
      setError(getError(declineError));
    }
  }

  async function endCall() {
    if (!currentCall) return;
    const callId = currentCall.id;
    setError("");
    try {
      const callRef = doc(db, "callSessions", callId);
      const callSnapshot = await getDoc(callRef);
      if (callSnapshot.exists() && ["ringing", "active"].includes(callSnapshot.data().status)) {
        await updateDoc(callRef, {
          status: "ended",
          offer: null,
          answer: null,
          updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
          endedAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
      }
      await removeCallSignals(callId);
      finishLocalCall("The call has ended.");
    } catch (endError) {
      setError(getError(endError));
    }
  }

  function toggleMuted() {
    const enabled = !muted;
    localStreamRef.current?.getAudioTracks().forEach((track) => { track.enabled = !enabled; });
    setMuted(enabled);
  }

  function toggleCamera() {
    const disabled = !cameraOff;
    localStreamRef.current?.getVideoTracks().forEach((track) => { track.enabled = !disabled; });
    setCameraOff(disabled);
  }

  const activeGroup = groups.find((group) => group.id === groupId);
  const incomingCalls = calls.filter((call) => call.calleeUid === user?.uid && call.status === "ringing");
  const outgoingCalls = calls.filter((call) => call.callerUid === user?.uid && call.status === "ringing");
  const incomingCallId = incomingCalls[0]?.id;
  const incomingCallType = incomingCalls[0]?.callType;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (embedded && incomingCallType) {
      onIncomingCall?.(incomingCallType);
    }
  }, [embedded, incomingCallId, incomingCallType, onIncomingCall]);

  if (authLoading || loadingGroups) return <LoadingState label="Loading your prayer groupsâ€¦" />;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {!embedded && <PageHeading
        eyebrow="Together"
        title="Prayer calls"
        description="Connect with someone from one of your prayer groups for a private audio or video prayer."
      />}
      {error && <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-800">{error}</p>}
      {callQueryError && <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-800">{callQueryError}</p>}
      {notice && <p role="status" className="rounded-xl border border-teal-200 bg-teal-50 p-3 text-sm text-teal-900">{notice}</p>}

      {currentCall ? (
        <Panel className={embedded ? "border-0 shadow-none" : ""}>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-teal-700">
                {currentCall.callType === "video" ? "Video call" : "Audio call"}
              </p>
              <h2 className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold text-slate-950">
                {currentCall.otherName || "Prayer group member"}
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">
                {connecting ? "Connectingâ€¦" : connectionState === "connected" ? "Connected" : "Waiting for a secure peer connection"}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className={`grid gap-3 ${currentCall.callType === "video" ? "sm:grid-cols-2" : ""}`}>
              {currentCall.callType === "video" && (
                <>
                  <video ref={remoteVideoRef} autoPlay playsInline className="aspect-video w-full rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 object-cover" />
                  <video ref={localVideoRef} autoPlay playsInline muted className="aspect-video w-full rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 object-cover" />
                </>
              )}
              {currentCall.callType === "audio" && (
                <>
                  <audio ref={remoteAudioRef} autoPlay />
                  <div className="grid min-h-40 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-teal-50 text-teal-900">
                    <span className="text-5xl" aria-hidden="true">â™ª</span>
                    <span className="sr-only">Audio call</span>
                  </div>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <SecondaryButton type="button" onClick={toggleMuted}>{muted ? "Unmute" : "Mute microphone"}</SecondaryButton>
              {currentCall.callType === "video" && (
                <SecondaryButton type="button" onClick={toggleCamera}>{cameraOff ? "Turn camera on" : "Turn camera off"}</SecondaryButton>
              )}
              <button type="button" onClick={endCall} className="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-red-700 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-red-800">
                End call
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Panel>
      ) : embedded && incomingCalls.length > 0 ? (
        <Panel className="border-0 shadow-none">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-teal-700">Incoming internet call</p>
          <h2 className="mt-2 text-xl font-bold text-slate-950">{incomingCalls[0].callerName || "A prayer group member"} is calling</h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">{incomingCalls[0].callType === "video" ? "Video call" : "Audio call"} Â· uses Wi-Fi or mobile data</p>
          <div className="mt-5 flex gap-2">
            <PrimaryButton type="button" disabled={connecting} onClick={() => acceptCall(incomingCalls[0])}>Answer</PrimaryButton>
            <SecondaryButton type="button" disabled={connecting} onClick={() => declineCall(incomingCalls[0])}>Decline</SecondaryButton>
          </div>
        </Panel>
      ) : (
        <div className={embedded ? "space-y-4" : "grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-2"}>
          <Panel className={embedded ? "border-0 shadow-none" : ""}>
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{embedded ? `${callType === "video" ? "Video" : "Audio"} internet call` : "Start a call"}</h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">Uses Wi-Fi or mobile data, not your phone minutes.</p>
              </div>
              {embedded && (
                <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close call window" className="rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100">
                  Ã—
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            {groups.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="mt-4">
                <EmptyState title="Join a prayer group first" description="Calls are only available between members of the same prayer group." />
              </div>
            ) : (
              <form onSubmit={startCall} className="mt-4 space-y-4">
                {!embedded && <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-800">
                  Prayer group
                  <select className="auth-input mt-1.5" value={groupId} onChange={(event) => { setGroupId(event.target.value); setCalleeUid(""); }}>
                    {groups.map((group) => <option key={group.id} value={group.id}>{group.name}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </label>}
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-800">
                  Call a group member
                  <select className="auth-input mt-1.5" value={calleeUid} onChange={(event) => setCalleeUid(event.target.value)} required>
                    <option value="">Choose a member</option>
                    {(activeGroup?.members || []).map((member) => (
                      <option key={member.uid} value={member.uid}>{member.displayName || "Prayer group member"}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </label>
                {!embedded && <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-800">
                  Call type
                  <select className="auth-input mt-1.5" value={callType} onChange={(event) => setCallType(event.target.value)}>
                    <option value="audio">Audio</option>
                    <option value="video">Video</option>
                  </select>
                </label>}
                <PrimaryButton type="submit" disabled={connecting || !calleeUid}>
                  {connecting ? "Starting callâ€¦" : `Start ${callType} call`}
                </PrimaryButton>
                <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">
                  Both people need to be online in this group chat to answer. Allow microphone access when prompted; video also needs camera access. Direct peer-to-peer calls may reveal your network IP address to the other participant.
                </p>
              </form>
            )}
          </Panel>
          {!embedded && <Panel>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">Call invitations</h2>
            <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
              {incomingCalls.map((call) => (
                <div key={call.id} className="rounded-xl border border-teal-100 bg-teal-50/70 p-4">
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">{call.callerName || "A prayer group member"} is calling</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">{call.callType === "video" ? "Video" : "Audio"} prayer call</p>
                  <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2">
                    <PrimaryButton type="button" disabled={connecting} onClick={() => acceptCall(call)}>Answer</PrimaryButton>
                    <SecondaryButton type="button" disabled={connecting} onClick={() => declineCall(call)}>Decline</SecondaryButton>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
              {outgoingCalls.map((call) => (
                <div key={call.id} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-4">
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">Calling {call.calleeName || "a prayer group member"}</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">Waiting for an answerâ€¦</p>
                  <SecondaryButton type="button" className="mt-3" onClick={() => setCurrentCall({
                    id: call.id,
                    callerUid: call.callerUid,
                    calleeUid: call.calleeUid,
                    callType: call.callType,
                    otherName: call.calleeName
                  })}>Return to call</SecondaryButton>
                </div>
              ))}
              {incomingCalls.length === 0 && outgoingCalls.length === 0 && (
                <p className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-4 text-sm text-slate-600">There are no incoming or outgoing calls right now.</p>
              )}
            </div>
          </Panel>}
        </div>
      )}
      <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">
        Calls use a direct peer-to-peer connection. Some networks or firewalls require a TURN relay; if a direct connection cannot be established, ask your administrator to configure a trusted TURN service.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  addDoc,
  collection,
  collectionGroup,
  deleteDoc,
  doc,
  getDoc,
  limit,
  onSnapshot,
  orderBy,
  query,
  serverTimestamp,
  setDoc,
  updateDoc,
  where,
  writeBatch
} from "firebase/firestore";
import { getFirebaseDb } from "@/lib/firebase";
import { useCurrentUser } from "@/hooks/useCurrentUser";
import {
  EmptyState,
  LoadingState,
  Notice,
  PageHeading,
  Panel,
  PrimaryButton,
  SecondaryButton,
  SelectField,
  TextAreaField,
  formatDate
} from "@/components/ui/DashboardPrimitives";

const db = getFirebaseDb();

function describeError(error) {
  if (error.code === "permission-denied") return "You don't have permission to access this post.";
  if (error.code === "unavailable") return "The service is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.";
  return error.message || "The change could not be saved. Please try again.";
}

export default function HeatRoomWorkspace() {
  const { user, loading: authLoading } = useCurrentUser();
  const [feedPosts, setFeedPosts] = useState([]);
  const [anonymousPosts, setAnonymousPosts] = useState([]);
  const [groups, setGroups] = useState([]);
  const [groupIds, setGroupIds] = useState([]);
  const [defaultAudience, setDefaultAudience] = useState("public");
  const [anonymousPostKeys, setAnonymousPostKeys] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [posting, setPosting] = useState(false);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState("prayer");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return undefined;
    const stopProfile = onSnapshot(
      doc(db, "users", user.uid),
      (snapshot) => {
        const preferred = snapshot.data()?.privacyPreferences?.defaultPostAudience;
        if (preferred === "public" || preferred === "private") setDefaultAudience(preferred);
      },
      (snapshotError) => setError(describeError(snapshotError))
    );
    return () => stopProfile();
  }, [user]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return undefined;
    const stopMemberships = onSnapshot(
      query(collectionGroup(db, "members"), where("uid", "==", user.uid)),
      (snapshot) => {
        const memberships = snapshot.docs.map((member) => member.ref.parent.parent?.id).filter(Boolean);
        setGroupIds(memberships);
        if (memberships.length === 0) setGroups([]);
      },
      (snapshotError) => setError(describeError(snapshotError))
    );
    return () => stopMemberships();
  }, [user]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user || groupIds.length === 0) return undefined;
    const stops = groupIds.map((groupId) =>
      onSnapshot(doc(db, "prayerGroups", groupId), (snapshot) => {
        if (snapshot.exists()) {
          setGroups((current) => [...current.filter((group) => group.id !== groupId), { id: groupId, ...snapshot.data() }]);
        }
      }, (snapshotError) => setError(describeError(snapshotError)))
    );
    return () => stops.forEach((stop) => stop());
  }, [groupIds, user]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return undefined;
    const feeds = new Map();
    const updateFeed = (key, snapshots) => {
      feeds.set(key, snapshots.map((post) => ({ id: post.id, ...post.data() })));
      setFeedPosts(
        Array.from(
          Array.from(feeds.values())
            .flat()
            .filter((post) => post.status !== "deleted")
            .reduce((unique, post) => unique.set(`${post.type}/${post.id}`, post), new Map())
            .values()
        ).sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt?.toMillis?.() || 0) - (a.createdAt?.toMillis?.() || 0))
      );
      setLoading(false);
    };
    const stops = [];
    const connect = (key, postType, constraints) => {
      stops.push(
        onSnapshot(
          query(collection(db, postType), ...constraints),
          (snapshot) => {
            updateFeed(key, snapshot.docs.map((post) => ({
              id: post.id,
              ref: post.ref,
              data: () => post.data()
            })));
            setError("");
          },
          (snapshotError) => {
            setError(describeError(snapshotError));
            setLoading(false);
          }
        )
      );
    };
    for (const postType of ["prayerRequests", "testimonies"]) {
      connect(`${postType}-public`, postType, [
        where("audience", "==", "public"),
        where("status", "==", "active"),
        orderBy("createdAt", "desc"),
        limit(40)
      ]);
      connect(`${postType}-own`, postType, [
        where("authorUid", "==", user.uid),
        where("status", "==", "active"),
        orderBy("createdAt", "desc"),
        limit(40)
      ]);
      if (groupIds.length > 0) {
        connect(`${postType}-groups`, postType, [
          where("audience", "==", "group"),
          where("groupId", "in", groupIds.slice(0, 10)),
          where("status", "==", "active"),
          orderBy("createdAt", "desc"),
          limit(40)
        ]);
      } else {
        feeds.set(`${postType}-groups`, []);
      }
    }
    return () => stops.forEach((stop) => stop());
  }, [groupIds, user]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return undefined;
    let live = true;
    const stopIdentities = onSnapshot(
      query(collectionGroup(db, "moderation"), where("uid", "==", user.uid)),
      async (snapshot) => {
        try {
          const identities = await Promise.all(
            snapshot.docs.map(async (identity) => {
              const postRef = identity.ref.parent.parent;
              if (!postRef) return null;
              const postSnapshot = await getDoc(postRef);
              if (!postSnapshot.exists()) return null;
              const type = postRef.parent.id;
              return { id: postSnapshot.id, type, ...postSnapshot.data() };
            })
          );
          if (!live) return;
          setAnonymousPostKeys(
            identities.filter(Boolean).map((entry) => `${entry.type}/${entry.id}`)
          );
          setAnonymousPosts(identities.filter((entry) => entry && entry.status !== "deleted"));
        } catch (identityError) {
          setError(describeError(identityError));
        }
      },
      (snapshotError) => setError(describeError(snapshotError))
    );
    return () => {
      live = false;
      stopIdentities();
    };
  }, [user]);

  const visiblePosts = useMemo(
    () =>
      Array.from(
        [...feedPosts, ...anonymousPosts].reduce(
          (unique, post) => unique.set(`${post.type}/${post.id}`, post),
          new Map()
        ).values()
      ).sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt?.toMillis?.() || 0) - (a.createdAt?.toMillis?.() || 0)),
    [anonymousPosts, feedPosts]
  );

  async function createPost(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!user) return;
    const formElement = event.currentTarget;
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    const text = String(form.get("text") || "").trim();
    const audience = String(form.get("audience") || "public");
    const groupId = String(form.get("groupId") || "");
    const anonymous = kind === "prayer" && form.get("anonymous") === "on";
    if (text.length < 4 || text.length > 3000) {
      setError("Write between 4 and 3,000 characters.");
      return;
    }
    if (audience === "group" && (!groupId || !groupIds.includes(groupId))) {
      setError("Choose one of your joined prayer groups.");
      return;
    }
    setPosting(true);
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      const postType = kind === "prayer" ? "prayerRequests" : "testimonies";
      const postRef = doc(collection(db, postType));
      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      const postData = {
        type: postType,
        text,
        audience,
        groupId: audience === "group" ? groupId : null,
        status: "active",
        createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
      };
      if (!anonymous) {
        postData.authorUid = user.uid;
        postData.authorName = user.displayName || user.email?.split("@")[0] || "Community member";
        postData.authorPhotoURL = user.photoURL || null;
      } else {
        postData.anonymous = true;
      }
      batch.set(postRef, postData);
      if (anonymous) {
        batch.set(doc(db, postType, postRef.id, "moderation", "identity"), {
          uid: user.uid,
          createdAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
      }
      await batch.commit();
      formElement.reset();
      setNotice(anonymous ? "Your anonymous prayer request was shared." : "Your post was shared.");
    } catch (postError) {
      setError(describeError(postError));
    } finally {
      setPosting(false);
    }
  }

  async function softDelete(post) {
    if (!window.confirm("Remove this post from the community feed?")) return;
    setError("");
    try {
      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      batch.update(doc(db, post.type, post.id), {
        status: "deleted",
        text: "",
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
      if (post.anonymous) batch.delete(doc(db, post.type, post.id, "moderation", "identity"));
      await batch.commit();
      setNotice("The post was removed from the feed.");
    } catch (deleteError) {
      setError(describeError(deleteError));
    }
  }

  if (authLoading || loading) return <LoadingState label="Opening the Heat Roomâ€¦" />;
  if (!user) return <Notice>Please sign in again to open the Heat Room.</Notice>;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeading
        eyebrow="Community care"
        title="The Heat Room"
        description="A place to carry prayer requests together and celebrate what God is doing."
      />

      <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_300px]">
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {visiblePosts.length === 0 ? (
            <Panel>
              <EmptyState
                title="Start the conversation"
                description="Share a request or testimony with your community. Your audience and privacy choices stay attached to each post."
              />
            </Panel>
          ) : (
            visiblePosts.map((post) => (
              <PostCard
                key={`${post.type}/${post.id}`}
                post={post}
                user={user}
                isOwner={post.authorUid === user.uid || anonymousPostKeys.includes(`${post.type}/${post.id}`)}
                onDelete={() => softDelete(post)}
                onError={setError}
              />
            ))
          )}
        </div>

        <aside className="space-y-5">
          <Panel>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Share with care</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">
              Prayer requests and testimonies can be shared publicly, with a group, or privately with you.
            </p>
            <div className="mt-5 flex gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={kind === "prayer"}
                onClick={() => setKind("prayer")}
                className={`flex-1 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold ${kind === "prayer" ? "bg-teal-800 text-white" : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700"}`}
              >
                Prayer request
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={kind === "testimony"}
                onClick={() => setKind("testimony")}
                className={`flex-1 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold ${kind === "testimony" ? "bg-teal-800 text-white" : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700"}`}
              >
                Testimony
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={createPost} className="mt-4 space-y-4">
              <TextAreaField
                id="heat-post-text"
                name="text"
                label={kind === "prayer" ? "What would you like prayer for?" : "What would you like to celebrate?"}
                required
                minLength={4}
                maxLength={3000}
                rows={5}
              />
              <SelectField
                key={defaultAudience}
                id="post-audience"
                name="audience"
                label="Who can see this?"
                defaultValue={defaultAudience}
              >
                <option value="public">Everyone in the community</option>
                <option value="group" disabled={groups.length === 0}>One of my groups</option>
                <option value="private">Only me</option>
              </SelectField>
              <label className="block">
                <span className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-800">Prayer group</span>
                <select name="groupId" className="auth-input" defaultValue="" disabled={groups.length === 0}>
                  <option value="">Choose a group (if sharing with a group)</option>
                  {groups.map((group) => <option key={group.id} value={group.id}>{group.name}</option>)}
                </select>
              </label>
              {kind === "prayer" && (
                <label className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3 text-sm text-slate-700">
                  <input type="checkbox" name="anonymous" className="mt-1 accent-teal-800" />
                  <span>
                    Share anonymously
                    <span className="mt-1 block text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">
                      Your name is hidden from readers. Only your private account can access the moderation identity.
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </label>
              )}
              <PrimaryButton type="submit" disabled={posting} className="w-full">
                {posting ? "Sharingâ€¦" : kind === "prayer" ? "Share prayer request" : "Share testimony"}
              </PrimaryButton>
            </form>
          </Panel>

          <Panel className="border-sky-100 bg-sky-50/60">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">A gentle reminder</h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">
              Avoid posting passwords, financial information, or details that could put you or someone else at risk.
            </p>

        </aside>
      </div>

      {(error || notice) && (

          <Notice tone={error ? "error" : "success"}>{error || notice}</Notice>
        </div>

function PostCard({ post, user, isOwner, onDelete, onError }) {
  const [isPraying, setIsPraying] = useState(false);
  const [reacted, setReacted] = useState(false);
  const [showComments, setShowComments] = useState(false);
  const [comments, setComments] = useState([]);
  const [comment, setComment] = useState("");
  const [savingComment, setSavingComment] = useState(false);
  const interactions = post.type === "prayerRequests" ? "prayingUsers" : "reactions";

  useEffect(() => {
    const interactionRef = doc(db, post.type, post.id, interactions, user.uid);
    return onSnapshot(interactionRef, (snapshot) => {
      if (post.type === "prayerRequests") setIsPraying(snapshot.exists());
      else setReacted(snapshot.exists());
    }, onError);
  }, [interactions, onError, post.id, post.type, user.uid]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!showComments) return undefined;
    return onSnapshot(
      query(collection(db, post.type, post.id, "comments"), orderBy("createdAt", "asc"), limit(30)),
      (snapshot) => setComments(snapshot.docs.map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))),
      onError
    );
  }, [post.id, post.type, showComments, onError]);

  async function toggleAcknowledgment() {
    onError("");
    const ref = doc(db, post.type, post.id, interactions, user.uid);
    try {
      if (post.type === "prayerRequests") {
        if (isPraying) await deleteDoc(ref);
        else await setDoc(ref, { uid: user.uid, createdAt: serverTimestamp() });
      } else if (reacted) {
        await deleteDoc(ref);
      } else {
        await setDoc(ref, { uid: user.uid, emoji: "heart", createdAt: serverTimestamp() });
      }
    } catch (interactionError) {
      onError(describeError(interactionError));
    }
  }

  async function addComment(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const text = comment.trim();
    if (text.length < 1 || text.length > 1000) return;
    setSavingComment(true);
    onError("");
    try {
      await addDoc(collection(db, post.type, post.id, "comments"), {
        uid: user.uid,
        authorName: user.displayName || user.email?.split("@")[0] || "Community member",
        text,
        createdAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
      setComment("");
    } catch (commentError) {
      onError(describeError(commentError));
    } finally {
      setSavingComment(false);
    }
  }

  async function reportPost() {
    const reason = window.prompt("Briefly tell us why you're reporting this post.");
    if (!reason?.trim()) return;
    if (reason.trim().length > 300) {
      onError("Report notes must be 300 characters or fewer.");
      return;
    }
    onError("");
    try {
      await addDoc(collection(db, "reports"), {
        reporterUid: user.uid,
        contentType: post.type,
        contentId: post.id,
        reason: reason.trim(),
        createdAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
      window.alert("Thank you. Your report was recorded for moderator review.");
    } catch (reportError) {
      onError(describeError(reportError));
    }
  }

  const audience = post.audience === "public" ? "Community" : post.audience === "group" ? "Group members" : "Private";
  return (
    <Panel>
      <article>
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
            <span className="grid h-10 w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-teal-100 text-sm font-semibold text-teal-900">
              {post.anonymous ? "?" : (post.authorName || "M").slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}
            </span>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
                {post.anonymous ? "Anonymous community member" : post.authorName || "Community member"}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500">
                {post.type === "testimonies" ? "Testimony" : "Prayer request"} Â· {formatDate(post.createdAt)}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-600">
            {audience}
          </span>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-4 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">{post.text}</p>

        <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
          <SecondaryButton type="button" onClick={toggleAcknowledgment}>
            {post.type === "prayerRequests"
              ? isPraying ? "Praying âœ“" : "Iâ€™m praying"
              : reacted ? "Grateful â™¥" : "Celebrate"}
          </SecondaryButton>
          <SecondaryButton type="button" onClick={() => setShowComments((value) => !value)}>
            {showComments ? "Hide replies" : "Encourage"}
          </SecondaryButton>
          {isOwner ? (
            <button type="button" onClick={onDelete} className="ml-auto text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 hover:text-red-700">
              Remove post
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button type="button" onClick={reportPost} className="ml-auto text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 hover:text-red-700">
              Report
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {showComments && (
          <div className="mt-4 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {comments.map((entry) => (
                <div key={entry.id} className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800">{entry.authorName}</p>
                    <time className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">{formatDate(entry.createdAt)}</time>
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-5 text-slate-700">{entry.text}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
              {comments.length === 0 && <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Be the first to offer encouragement.</p>}
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={addComment} className="mt-3 flex gap-2">
              <label htmlFor={`comment-${post.id}`} className="sr-only">Write an encouraging reply</label>
              <input
                id={`comment-${post.id}`}
                className="auth-input min-w-0 flex-1"
                placeholder="Write a kind replyâ€¦"
                maxLength={1000}
                value={comment}
                onChange={(event) => setComment(event.target.value)}
              />
              <PrimaryButton type="submit" disabled={savingComment || !comment.trim()}>
                {savingComment ? "â€¦" : "Reply"}
              </PrimaryButton>
            </form>
          </div>
        )}
      </article>
    </Panel>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { EmptyState, LoadingState, Notice, PageHeading, Panel, SecondaryButton } from "@/components/ui/DashboardPrimitives";

function formatCreatedAt(value) {
  const seconds = value?._seconds ?? value?.seconds;
  if (!seconds) return "Recently reported";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" })
    .format(new Date(seconds * 1000));
}

export default function ModerationWorkspace() {
  const [reports, setReports] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");

  const loadReports = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/moderation/reports", { cache: "no-store" });
      const result = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || "Unable to load reports.");
      setReports(result.reports || []);
      setError("");
    } catch (loadError) {
      setError(loadError.message || "Unable to load reports.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    fetch("/api/moderation/reports", { cache: "no-store" })
      .then(async (response) => {
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || "Unable to load reports.");
        return result;
      })
      .then((result) => {
        if (live) {
          setReports(result.reports || []);
          setError("");
        }
      })
      .catch((loadError) => {
        if (live) setError(loadError.message || "Unable to load reports.");
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (live) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);

  async function review(report, action) {
    setBusyId(report.id);
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/moderation/reports", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ reportId: report.id, action })
      });
      const result = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || "Unable to process this report.");
      setNotice(action === "remove" ? "Reported content removed." : "Report dismissed.");
      await loadReports();
    } catch (reviewError) {
      setError(reviewError.message || "Unable to process this report.");
    } finally {
      setBusyId("");
    }
  }

  if (loading) return <LoadingState label="Loading moderation reportsâ€¦" />;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeading
        eyebrow="Community safety"
        title="Moderation reports"
        description="Review user reports and remove content that violates community guidelines."
        action={<SecondaryButton type="button" onClick={loadReports}>Refresh reports</SecondaryButton>}
      />
      {error && <div className="mb-4"><Notice>{error}</Notice></div>}
      {notice && <div className="mb-4"><Notice tone="success">{notice}</Notice></div>}
      {reports.length === 0 ? (
        <Panel><EmptyState title="No reports to review" description="New reports will appear here for moderator review." /></Panel>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {reports.map((report) => (
            <Panel key={report.id}>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-teal-800">
                    {report.contentType === "prayerRequests" ? "Prayer request" : "Testimony"} Â· {formatCreatedAt(report.createdAt)}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
                    Report reason: <span className="font-normal">{report.reason}</span>
                  </p>
                  {report.content ? (
                    <>
                      <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">
                        {report.content.authorName} Â· {report.content.status}
                      </p>
                      <p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-6 text-slate-700">
                        {report.content.text || "This content has already been removed."}
                      </p>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-slate-500">The reported content no longer exists.</p>
                  )}
                </div>
                {!report.reviewStatus && (
                  <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-2">
                    <SecondaryButton
                      type="button"
                      disabled={busyId === report.id}
                      onClick={() => review(report, "dismiss")}
                    >
                      Dismiss
                    </SecondaryButton>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={busyId === report.id || !report.content}
                      onClick={() => review(report, "remove")}
                      className="rounded-xl bg-red-700 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-red-800 disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                      {busyId === report.id ? "Savingâ€¦" : "Remove content"}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
                {report.reviewStatus && (
                  <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    {report.reviewStatus}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </Panel>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { doc, onSnapshot, runTransaction, serverTimestamp } from "firebase/firestore";
import { useCurrentUser } from "@/hooks/useCurrentUser";
import { getFirebaseDb } from "@/lib/firebase";
import { GroupRoom } from "@/features/prayer/PrayerWorkspace";
import { LoadingState, Notice } from "@/components/ui/DashboardPrimitives";

const db = getFirebaseDb();

export default function GroupChatPage({ groupId }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { user, loading: authLoading } = useCurrentUser();
  const [group, setGroup] = useState(null);
  const [isMember, setIsMember] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user || !groupId) return undefined;
    let groupLoaded = false;
    let membershipLoaded = false;
    const finishLoading = () => {
      if (groupLoaded && membershipLoaded) setLoading(false);
    };
    const stopGroup = onSnapshot(
      doc(db, "prayerGroups", groupId),
      (snapshot) => {
        setGroup(snapshot.exists() ? { id: snapshot.id, ...snapshot.data() } : null);
        groupLoaded = true;
        finishLoading();
      },
      (snapshotError) => {
        setError(snapshotError.message || "This prayer group could not be loaded.");
        groupLoaded = true;
        finishLoading();
      }
    );
    const stopMembership = onSnapshot(
      doc(db, "prayerGroups", groupId, "members", user.uid),
      (snapshot) => {
        setIsMember(snapshot.exists());
        membershipLoaded = true;
        finishLoading();
      },
      (snapshotError) => {
        setError(snapshotError.message || "Your group membership could not be checked.");
        membershipLoaded = true;
        finishLoading();
      }
    );
    return () => {
      stopGroup();
      stopMembership();
    };
  }, [groupId, user]);

  async function removeMember(member) {
    if (!user || !group) return;
    const groupRef = doc(db, "prayerGroups", group.id);
    const membershipRef = doc(db, "prayerGroups", group.id, "members", member.uid);
    await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
      const [groupSnapshot, membershipSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
        transaction.get(groupRef),
        transaction.get(membershipRef)
      ]);
      if (!groupSnapshot.exists() || !membershipSnapshot.exists()) return;
      if (groupSnapshot.data().creatorUid !== user.uid || membershipSnapshot.data().role !== "member") {
        throw new Error("Only the group administrator can remove a regular member.");
      }
      transaction.delete(membershipRef);
      transaction.update(groupRef, {
        memberCount: Math.max(0, (groupSnapshot.data().memberCount || 1) - 1),
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
    });
  }

  async function leaveGroup() {
    if (!user || !group) return;
    const groupRef = doc(db, "prayerGroups", group.id);
    const membershipRef = doc(db, "prayerGroups", group.id, "members", user.uid);
    await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
      const [groupSnapshot, membershipSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
        transaction.get(groupRef),
        transaction.get(membershipRef)
      ]);
      if (!groupSnapshot.exists() || !membershipSnapshot.exists()) return;
      if (membershipSnapshot.data().role === "admin") {
        throw new Error("Group administrators can't leave. Delete the group or transfer administration first.");
      }
      transaction.delete(membershipRef);
      transaction.update(groupRef, {
        memberCount: Math.max(0, (groupSnapshot.data().memberCount || 1) - 1),
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
    });
    router.replace("/prayer");
  }

  async function deleteGroup(confirmation) {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/prayer-groups/${encodeURIComponent(groupId)}`, {
      method: "DELETE",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ confirmation })
    });
    const result = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || "The group could not be deleted.");
    router.replace("/prayer");
  }

  if (authLoading || loading) return <LoadingState label="Opening your prayer roomâ€¦" />;
  if (error) return <Notice>{error}</Notice>;
  if (!group) return <Notice>This prayer group no longer exists.</Notice>;
  if (!user || !isMember) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <Notice>You must be a member of this prayer group to open its chat.</Notice>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => router.replace("/prayer")} className="text-sm font-semibold text-teal-800 hover:underline">
          Back to prayer groups
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <GroupRoom
      key={group.id}
      group={group}
      user={user}
      isAdmin={group.creatorUid === user.uid}
      onLeave={leaveGroup}
      onRemoveMember={removeMember}
      onDeleteGroup={deleteGroup}
      onClose={() => router.push("/prayer")}
    />
  );
}

const db = getFirebaseDb();

function getActionError(error) {
  if (error.code === "permission-denied") {
    return "You don't have permission to do that. Refresh the page and try again.";
  }
  if (error.code === "unavailable") {
    return "You're offline or the service is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.";
  }
  return error.message || "The change could not be saved. Please try again.";
}

export default function PrayerWorkspace() {
  const { user, loading: authLoading } = useCurrentUser();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [groups, setGroups] = useState([]);
  const [groupIds, setGroupIds] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [showCreate, setShowCreate] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return undefined;

    const stopGroups = onSnapshot(
      query(
        collection(db, "prayerGroups"),
        where("visibility", "==", "public"),
        orderBy("updatedAt", "desc"),
        limit(50)
      ),
      (snapshot) => {
        setGroups(snapshot.docs.map((groupDoc) => ({ id: groupDoc.id, ...groupDoc.data() })));
        setLoading(false);
        setError("");
      },
      (snapshotError) => {
        setError(getActionError(snapshotError));
        setLoading(false);
      }
    );

    const stopMemberships = onSnapshot(
      query(collectionGroup(db, "members"), where("uid", "==", user.uid)),
      (snapshot) => {
        setGroupIds(
          snapshot.docs
            .map((membership) => membership.ref.parent.parent?.id)
            .filter(Boolean)
        );
      },
      (snapshotError) => setError(getActionError(snapshotError))
    );

    return () => {
      stopGroups();
      stopMemberships();
    };
  }, [user]);

  const filteredGroups = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    if (!needle) return groups;
    return groups.filter(
      (group) =>
        group.name?.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
        group.description?.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle)
    );
  }, [groups, search]);

  const myGroups = groups.filter((group) => groupIds.includes(group.id));

  async function createGroup(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = event.currentTarget;
    const formData = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    const name = String(formData.get("name") || "").trim();
    const description = String(formData.get("description") || "").trim();
    if (!user || !name) return;

    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      const groupRef = doc(collection(db, "prayerGroups"));
      const creatorMembershipRef = doc(db, "prayerGroups", groupRef.id, "members", user.uid);
      await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
        transaction.set(groupRef, {
          name,
          description,
          creatorUid: user.uid,
          creatorName: user.displayName || user.email?.split("@")[0] || "Community member",
          visibility: "public",
          memberCount: 1,
          createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
          updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
        transaction.set(creatorMembershipRef, {
          uid: user.uid,
          displayName: user.displayName || user.email?.split("@")[0] || "Community member",
          groupName: name,
          role: "admin",
          joinedAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
      });
      setShowCreate(false);
      setNotice("Your prayer group is ready. You're its administrator.");
      router.push(`/prayer/${groupRef.id}`);
      form.reset();
    } catch (createError) {
      setError(getActionError(createError));
    }
  }

  async function joinGroup(group) {
    if (!user) return;
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      const groupRef = doc(db, "prayerGroups", group.id);
      const membershipRef = doc(db, "prayerGroups", group.id, "members", user.uid);
      await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
        const [groupSnapshot, membershipSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
          transaction.get(groupRef),
          transaction.get(membershipRef)
        ]);
        if (!groupSnapshot.exists()) throw new Error("This group is no longer available.");
        if (membershipSnapshot.exists()) return;
        transaction.update(groupRef, {
          memberCount: (groupSnapshot.data().memberCount || 0) + 1,
          updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
        transaction.set(membershipRef, {
          uid: user.uid,
          displayName: user.displayName || user.email?.split("@")[0] || "Community member",
          groupName: group.name,
          role: "member",
          joinedAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
      });
      router.push(`/prayer/${group.id}`);
      setNotice(`You joined ${group.name}.`);
    } catch (joinError) {
      setError(getActionError(joinError));
    }
  }

  if (authLoading || loading) return <LoadingState />;
  if (!user) return <Notice>Please sign in again to open your prayer community.</Notice>;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeading
