export function GroupRoom({ group, user, isAdmin, onLeave, onRemoveMember, onClose, onDeleteGroup }) {
  const [members, setMembers] = useState([]);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);
  const [olderMessages, setOlderMessages] = useState([]);
  const [loadingOlder, setLoadingOlder] = useState(false);
  const [hasOlderMessages, setHasOlderMessages] = useState(true);
  const [hasMessageCursor, setHasMessageCursor] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [callType, setCallType] = useState("");
  const [deleteDialogOpen, setDeleteDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleteConfirmation, setDeleteConfirmation] = useState("");
  const [deletingGroup, setDeletingGroup] = useState(false);
  const oldestMessageRef = useRef(null);
  const hasLoadedOlderRef = useRef(false);
  const openIncomingCall = useCallback((type) => setCallType(type), []);

  async function handleLeaveGroup() {
    try {
      await onLeave();
    } catch (leaveError) {
      setError(getActionError(leaveError));
    }
  }

  async function handleRemoveMember(member) {
    try {
      await onRemoveMember(member);
    } catch (removeError) {
      setError(getActionError(removeError));
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const membersQuery = query(collection(db, "prayerGroups", group.id, "members"));
    const messagesQuery = query(
      collection(db, "prayerGroups", group.id, "messages"),
      orderBy("createdAt", "desc"),
      limit(40)
    );
    const stopMembers = onSnapshot(
      membersQuery,
      (snapshot) =>
        setMembers(snapshot.docs.map((member) => member.data()).sort((a, b) => a.joinedAt?.seconds - b.joinedAt?.seconds)),
      (snapshotError) => setError(getActionError(snapshotError))
    );
    const stopMessages = onSnapshot(
      messagesQuery,
      (snapshot) => {
        if (!hasLoadedOlderRef.current) {
          oldestMessageRef.current = snapshot.docs[snapshot.docs.length - 1] || null;
        }
        setHasMessageCursor(snapshot.docs.length > 0);
        setMessages(snapshot.docs.map((message) => ({ id: message.id, ...message.data() })).reverse());
        if (snapshot.docs.length < 40) setHasOlderMessages(false);
      },
      (snapshotError) => setError(getActionError(snapshotError))
    );
    return () => {
      stopMembers();
      stopMessages();
    };
  }, [group.id]);

  async function loadOlderMessages() {
    if (!oldestMessageRef.current || loadingOlder || !hasOlderMessages) return;
    setLoadingOlder(true);
    setError("");
    hasLoadedOlderRef.current = true;
    try {
      const olderSnapshot = await getDocs(
        query(
          collection(db, "prayerGroups", group.id, "messages"),
          orderBy("createdAt", "desc"),
          startAfter(oldestMessageRef.current),
          limit(40)
        )
      );
      if (olderSnapshot.empty) {
        setHasOlderMessages(false);
        return;
      }
      oldestMessageRef.current = olderSnapshot.docs[olderSnapshot.docs.length - 1];
      setOlderMessages((current) => [
        ...current,
        ...olderSnapshot.docs.map((message) => ({ id: message.id, ...message.data() })).reverse()
      ]);
      setHasOlderMessages(olderSnapshot.docs.length === 40);
    } catch (loadError) {
      setError(getActionError(loadError));
    } finally {
      setLoadingOlder(false);
    }
  }

  async function sendMessage(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const text = draft.trim();
    if (!text || text.length > 2000) return;
    setSending(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await addDoc(collection(db, "prayerGroups", group.id, "messages"), {
        uid: user.uid,
        authorName: user.displayName || user.email?.split("@")[0] || "Community member",
        photoURL: user.photoURL || null,
        text,
        createdAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
      setDraft("");
    } catch (sendError) {
      setError(getActionError(sendError));
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="flex min-h-[min(76vh,780px)] flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-[0_22px_60px_-40px_rgba(22,50,37,0.42)]">
      <header className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 sm:px-6">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Back to prayer groups" className="grid h-10 w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100">
            <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" className="h-5 w-5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="m15 18-6-6 6-6M9 12h11" /></svg>
          </button>
          <span className="grid h-10 w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-teal-100 text-sm font-bold text-teal-900">
            {group.name.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}
          </span>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h1 className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-slate-950 sm:text-base">{group.name}</h1>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500">{members.length} members Â· private group chat</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 sm:gap-2">
          <button type="button" title="Start an audio internet call" aria-label="Start an audio internet call" onClick={() => setCallType("audio")} className="grid h-10 w-10 place-items-center rounded-full text-teal-800 transition hover:bg-teal-50">
            <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" className="h-5 w-5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><path d="M7.2 3.5H5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2c0 8.6 7 15.5 15.5 15.5a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-2.2l-4.6-2-1.8 2.2a14 14 0 0 1-7.1-7.1l2.2-1.8-2-4.6Z" /></svg>
          </button>
          <button type="button" title="Start a video internet call" aria-label="Start a video internet call" onClick={() => setCallType("video")} className="grid h-10 w-10 place-items-center rounded-full text-teal-800 transition hover:bg-teal-50">
            <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" className="h-5 w-5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="6" width="13" height="12" rx="2" /><path d="m16 10 5-3v10l-5-3" /></svg>
          </button>
          <details className="relative">
            <summary aria-label="Group information and settings" className="grid h-10 w-10 cursor-pointer list-none place-items-center rounded-full text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100">
              <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" className="h-5 w-5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round"><circle cx="5" cy="12" r="1" /><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1" /><circle cx="19" cy="12" r="1" /></svg>
            </summary>
            <div className="absolute right-0 top-12 z-20 w-64 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xl">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">Group members ({members.length})</p>
              <div className="mt-3 max-h-48 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto">
                {members.map((member) => (
                  <div key={member.uid} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm">
                    <span className="truncate text-slate-700">
                      {member.uid === user.uid ? "You" : member.displayName || "Member"}
                      {member.role === "admin" && <span className="ml-2 rounded-full bg-amber-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-amber-800">Admin</span>}
                    </span>
                    {isAdmin && member.uid !== user.uid && member.role !== "admin" && (
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => handleRemoveMember(member)} className="shrink-0 text-xs font-medium text-red-700 hover:underline">Remove</button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-4 border-t border-slate-100 pt-3">
                {isAdmin ? (
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(true)} className="text-sm font-semibold text-red-700 hover:underline">Delete group</button>
                ) : (
                  <button type="button" onClick={handleLeaveGroup} className="text-sm font-semibold text-red-700 hover:underline">Leave group</button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </details>
        </div>
      </header>
      <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-3 overflow-y-auto bg-[#efeae2] px-3 py-5 sm:px-6" aria-live="polite">
        <p className="mx-auto mb-2 max-w-sm rounded-xl bg-[#fbf2d8] px-3 py-2 text-center text-[11px] leading-5 text-slate-600 shadow-sm">
          Messages in this prayer room are only visible to group members.
        </p>
        {hasOlderMessages && hasMessageCursor && (
          <div className="text-center">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={loadOlderMessages}
              disabled={loadingOlder}
              className="text-xs font-semibold text-teal-800 hover:underline disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {loadingOlder ? "Loading older messagesâ€¦" : "Load older messages"}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
        {olderMessages.length + messages.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="py-8 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
            This room is quiet for now. Share a prayer or a word of encouragement.
          </p>
        ) : (
          [...olderMessages, ...messages].map((message) => {
            const ownMessage = message.uid === user.uid;
            return (
              <article key={message.id} className={`flex w-full ${ownMessage ? "justify-end" : "justify-start"}`}>
                <div className={`max-w-[88%] rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-2.5 shadow-sm sm:max-w-[75%] ${ownMessage ? "rounded-br-md bg-[#d9fdd3]" : "rounded-bl-md bg-white"}`}>
                  {!ownMessage && <p className="mb-1 text-xs font-bold text-teal-800">{message.authorName || "Community member"}</p>}
                  <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm leading-5 text-slate-800">{message.text}</p>
                  <time className="mt-1 block text-right text-[10px] text-slate-500">{formatDate(message.createdAt)}</time>
                </div>
              </article>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>
      <form onSubmit={sendMessage} className="flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-slate-200 bg-[#f7f8f6] p-3 sm:px-5">
        <label htmlFor={`message-${group.id}`} className="sr-only">Write to {group.name}</label>
        <input
          id={`message-${group.id}`}
          className="auth-input min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-full bg-white"
          placeholder="Write a messageâ€¦"
          maxLength={2000}
          value={draft}
          onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
        />
        <PrimaryButton type="submit" disabled={sending || !draft.trim()} className="min-h-11 w-11 shrink-0 rounded-full p-0" aria-label="Send message">
          {sending ? "â€¦" : <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" className="h-5 w-5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><path d="m22 2-7 20-4-9-9-4Z" /><path d="M22 2 11 13" /></svg>}
        </PrimaryButton>
      </form>
      {error && <p role="alert" className="border-t border-red-100 bg-red-50 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">{error}</p>}
      {deleteDialogOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] grid place-items-center bg-slate-950/45 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <form
            onSubmit={async (event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              if (deleteConfirmation !== group.name || deletingGroup) return;
              setDeletingGroup(true);
              setError("");
              try {
                await onDeleteGroup(group.name);
              } catch (deleteError) {
                setError(getActionError(deleteError));
                setDeletingGroup(false);
              }
            }}
            className="w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl"
          >
            <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-red-700">Delete prayer group</p>
            <h2 className="mt-2 text-xl font-bold text-slate-950">This cannot be undone</h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">
              This permanently deletes <strong>{group.name}</strong>, its messages and member records, and associated schedules and call sessions. Type the group name to confirm.
            </p>
            <input className="auth-input mt-4" value={deleteConfirmation} onChange={(event) => setDeleteConfirmation(event.target.value)} aria-label="Type group name to confirm deletion" autoComplete="off" />
            <div className="mt-5 flex justify-end gap-2">
              <SecondaryButton type="button" onClick={() => { setDeleteDialogOpen(false); setDeleteConfirmation(""); }}>Cancel</SecondaryButton>
              <button type="submit" disabled={deleteConfirmation !== group.name || deletingGroup} className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-red-700 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-red-800 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50">
                {deletingGroup ? "Deletingâ€¦" : "Delete group"}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}
      <div
        className={`fixed inset-0 z-[65] grid place-items-center bg-slate-950/50 p-3 backdrop-blur-sm transition-opacity sm:p-6 ${callType ? "opacity-100" : "pointer-events-none invisible opacity-0"}`}
        aria-hidden={!callType}
      >
          <section className="max-h-[90dvh] w-full max-w-3xl overflow-y-auto rounded-3xl bg-white shadow-2xl">
            <CallsWorkspace
              key={`${group.id}-${callType || "idle"}`}
              embeddedGroupId={group.id}
              embeddedCallType={callType || "audio"}
              embedded
              onIncomingCall={openIncomingCall}
              onClose={() => setCallType("")}
            />
          </section>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import {
  collectionGroup,
  deleteDoc,
  doc,
  onSnapshot,
  serverTimestamp,
  setDoc,
  updateDoc,
  where,
  query
} from "firebase/firestore";
import { getDownloadURL, ref, uploadBytesResumable } from "firebase/storage";
import {
  EmailAuthProvider,
  reauthenticateWithCredential,
  sendPasswordResetEmail,
  updateProfile,
  verifyBeforeUpdateEmail
} from "firebase/auth";
import { deleteToken, getMessaging, getToken, isSupported } from "firebase/messaging";
import { app, getFirebaseAuth, getFirebaseDb, storage } from "@/lib/firebase";
import { useCurrentUser } from "@/hooks/useCurrentUser";
import {
  Field,
  LoadingState,
  Notice,
  PageHeading,
  Panel,
  PrimaryButton,
  SecondaryButton,
  TextAreaField
} from "@/components/ui/DashboardPrimitives";

const db = getFirebaseDb();
const NOTIFICATION_DEFAULTS = {
  groupActivity: true,
  scheduleReminders: true,
  prayerEncouragement: true
};
const MAX_AVATAR_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_AVATAR_DIMENSION = 1280;

function getError(error) {
  if (error.code === "permission-denied") return "You don't have permission to update this profile.";
  if (error.code === "storage/unauthorized") return "The profile photo upload was denied. Sign in again and retry.";
  if ([
    "storage/bucket-not-found",
    "storage/no-default-bucket",
    "storage/project-not-found",
    "storage/retry-limit-exceeded"
  ].includes(error.code)) {
    return "The profile photo upload couldn't reach its Firebase Storage bucket. In Firebase Console, open Storage and select Get started, then verify NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET matches the bucket and deploy the Storage rules.";
  }
  if (error.code === "storage/unknown" && /bucket|not found|cors|network/i.test(error.message || "")) {
    return "The profile photo upload couldn't reach its Firebase Storage bucket. In Firebase Console, open Storage and select Get started, then verify NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET matches the bucket and deploy the Storage rules.";
  }
  if (error.code === "storage/canceled") return "The profile photo upload was canceled.";
  if (error.code === "auth/requires-recent-login") return "For your security, sign in again before changing this setting.";
  return error.message || "The change could not be saved. Please try again.";
}

async function prepareAvatar(file) {
  const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(file);
  try {
    const scale = Math.min(1, MAX_AVATAR_DIMENSION / Math.max(bitmap.width, bitmap.height));
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.width * scale));
    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.height * scale));
    const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!context) throw new Error("Your browser couldn't prepare this photo. Try another image.");
    context.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    const blob = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      canvas.toBlob(
        (result) => result ? resolve(result) : reject(new Error("Your photo couldn't be compressed. Try another image.")),
        "image/webp",
        0.82
      );
    });
    if (blob.size > MAX_AVATAR_SIZE) {
      throw new Error("This photo is still over 5 MB after resizing. Choose a smaller image.");
    }
    return blob;
  } finally {
    bitmap.close();
  }
}

export default function ProfileWorkspace() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { user, loading: authLoading } = useCurrentUser();
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState(null);
  const [groups, setGroups] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState(0);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [pushEnabled, setPushEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [updatingPush, setUpdatingPush] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return undefined;
    const stopProfile = onSnapshot(
      doc(db, "users", user.uid),
      (snapshot) => {
        setProfile(snapshot.exists() ? snapshot.data() : null);
        setLoading(false);
      },
      (snapshotError) => {
        setError(getError(snapshotError));
        setLoading(false);
      }
    );
    const stopMemberships = onSnapshot(
      query(collectionGroup(db, "members"), where("uid", "==", user.uid)),
      (snapshot) => {
        const memberships = snapshot.docs.map((membership) => ({
          id: membership.ref.parent.parent?.id,
          name: membership.data().groupName || membership.ref.parent.parent?.id,
          role: membership.data().role
        })).filter((membership) => membership.id);
        setGroups(memberships);
      },
      (snapshotError) => setError(getError(snapshotError))
    );
    return () => {
      stopProfile();
      stopMemberships();
    };
  }, [user]);

  async function saveProfile(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!user) return;
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    const displayName = String(form.get("displayName") || "").trim();
    const bio = String(form.get("bio") || "").trim();
    const phoneNumber = String(form.get("phoneNumber") || "").trim();
    if (displayName.length < 1 || displayName.length > 80) {
      setError("Your display name must be between 1 and 80 characters.");
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      await updateProfile(user, { displayName });
      await user.getIdToken(true);
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", user.uid), {
        displayName,
        bio,
        phoneNumber,
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
      setNotice("Your profile details were saved.");
    } catch (saveError) {
      setError(getError(saveError));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function uploadAvatar(event) {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];
    event.target.value = "";
    if (!user || !file) return;
    const allowedTypes = new Set(["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp"]);
    if (!allowedTypes.has(file.type)) {
      setError("Choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.");
      return;
    }
    if (file.size > MAX_AVATAR_SIZE) {
      setError("Profile photos must be 5 MB or smaller.");
      return;
    }
    setUploading(true);
    setUploadProgress(0);
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      const image = await prepareAvatar(file);
      const avatarRef = ref(storage, `users/${user.uid}/profile/avatar.webp`);
      const upload = uploadBytesResumable(avatarRef, image, { contentType: "image/webp" });
      await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        upload.on(
          "state_changed",
          (snapshot) => setUploadProgress(Math.round((snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100)),
          reject,
          resolve
        );
      });
      const photoURL = await getDownloadURL(avatarRef);
      await updateProfile(user, { photoURL });
      await user.getIdToken(true);
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", user.uid), { photoURL, updatedAt: serverTimestamp() });
      setNotice("Your profile photo was updated.");
    } catch (uploadError) {
      setError(getError(uploadError));
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
      setUploadProgress(0);
    }
  }

  async function changeEmail(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const formElement = event.currentTarget;
    if (!user) return;
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    const newEmail = String(form.get("email") || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!newEmail || newEmail === user.email?.toLowerCase()) {
      setError("Enter a different email address.");
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      await verifyBeforeUpdateEmail(user, newEmail, { url: `${window.location.origin}/profile` });
      setNotice("Check your new email address to confirm the change. Your profile will update after verification and your next sign-in.");
      formElement.reset();
    } catch (emailError) {
      setError(getError(emailError));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function sendPasswordReset() {
    if (!user?.email) return;
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      await sendPasswordResetEmail(getFirebaseAuth(), user.email);
      setNotice(`Password reset instructions were sent to ${user.email}.`);
    } catch (resetError) {
      setError(getError(resetError));
    }
  }

  async function togglePushNotifications() {
    if (!user) return;
    const vapidKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_VAPID_KEY;
    if (!vapidKey) {
      setError("Web push is not configured yet. Add NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_VAPID_KEY from Firebase Console â†’ Project Settings â†’ Cloud Messaging.");
      return;
    }

    setUpdatingPush(true);
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      if (!(await isSupported())) {
        throw new Error("This browser does not support Firebase web push notifications.");
      }
      const messaging = getMessaging(app);
      const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.register("/firebase-messaging-sw.js");
      await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;

      if (pushEnabled) {
        const token = await getToken(messaging, { vapidKey, serviceWorkerRegistration: registration });
        if (token) await deleteDoc(doc(db, "deviceTokens", token));
        await deleteToken(messaging);
        setPushEnabled(false);
        setNotice("Push notifications are disabled on this device.");
      } else {
        const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
        if (permission !== "granted") {
          throw new Error("Allow notifications in your browser settings to enable prayer updates.");
        }
        const token = await getToken(messaging, { vapidKey, serviceWorkerRegistration: registration });
        if (!token) throw new Error("The browser did not provide a push token. Try again.");
        await setDoc(doc(db, "deviceTokens", token), {
          uid: user.uid,
          token,
          updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
        setPushEnabled(true);
        setNotice("Push notifications are enabled on this device.");
      }
    } catch (pushError) {
      setError(getError(pushError));
    } finally {
      setUpdatingPush(false);
    }
  }

  async function deleteAccount(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!user?.email) return;
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    const password = String(form.get("password") || "");
    const confirmation = String(form.get("confirmation") || "");
    if (!password) {
      setError("Enter your password to verify your identity.");
      return;
    }
    if (confirmation !== "DELETE") {
      setError("Type DELETE exactly to confirm account removal.");
      return;
    }

    setDeleting(true);
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      const credential = EmailAuthProvider.credential(user.email, password);
      await reauthenticateWithCredential(user, credential);
      const sessionResponse = await fetch("/api/auth/session", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ idToken: await user.getIdToken(true) })
      });
      const sessionResult = await sessionResponse.json();
      if (!sessionResponse.ok) throw new Error(sessionResult.error || "Please sign in again.");

      const response = await fetch("/api/auth/delete-account", {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ confirmation })
      });
      const result = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || "Account deletion failed.");

      await getFirebaseAuth().signOut();
      router.replace("/login?accountDeleted=1");
    } catch (deleteError) {
      setError(getError(deleteError));
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
    }
  }

  async function updatePreference(section, key, checked) {
    if (!user) return;
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", user.uid), {
        [`${section}.${key}`]: checked,
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
      setNotice("Your preferences were updated.");
    } catch (preferenceError) {
      setError(getError(preferenceError));
    }
  }

  async function updateDefaultAudience(value) {
    if (!user || !["public", "private"].includes(value)) return;
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", user.uid), {
        "privacyPreferences.defaultPostAudience": value,
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
      setNotice("Your default post audience was updated.");
    } catch (preferenceError) {
      setError(getError(preferenceError));
    }
  }

  if (authLoading || loading) return <LoadingState label="Loading your profileâ€¦" />;
  if (!user || !profile) return <Notice>Your profile could not be loaded. Please sign out and back in.</Notice>;

  const notificationPreferences = { ...NOTIFICATION_DEFAULTS, ...profile.notificationPreferences };
  const defaultPostAudience = profile.privacyPreferences?.defaultPostAudience || "public";
  const avatar = profile.photoURL || user.photoURL;
  const initials = (profile.displayName || user.email || "M").slice(0, 1).toUpperCase();

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeading
        eyebrow="Your account"
        title="Profile & preferences"
        description="Keep your details current and choose how you want to participate."
      />

      <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_340px]">
        <div className="space-y-5">
          <Panel>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
              {avatar ? (
                // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                <img src={avatar} alt="" className="h-16 w-16 rounded-full object-cover ring-4 ring-teal-50" />
              ) : (
                <span className="grid h-16 w-16 place-items-center rounded-full bg-teal-100 text-xl font-semibold text-teal-900 ring-4 ring-teal-50">
                  {initials}
                </span>
              )}
              <div className="flex-1">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{profile.displayName || "Your profile"}</h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">{user.email}</p>
              </div>
              <label className="cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50">
                {uploading ? `Uploading ${uploadProgress}%â€¦` : "Change photo"}
                <input
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
                  disabled={uploading}
                  onChange={uploadAvatar}
                  className="sr-only"
                  aria-label="Upload profile photo"
                />
              </label>
            </div>
            {uploading && (
              <div className="mt-4" role="status" aria-live="polite">
                <div className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-teal-100">
                  <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-teal-700 transition-[width]" style={{ width: `${uploadProgress}%` }} />
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1 text-right text-xs text-slate-500">{uploadProgress}%</p>
              </div>
            )}
            <p className="mt-4 text-xs text-slate-500">JPEG, PNG, or WebP. Maximum file size: 5 MB.</p>
          </Panel>

          <Panel>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Your details</h2>
            <form onSubmit={saveProfile} className="mt-5 space-y-4">
              <Field
                id="profile-display-name"
                name="displayName"
                label="Display name"
                required
                maxLength={80}
                defaultValue={profile.displayName || user.displayName || ""}
              />
              <Field
                id="profile-phone"
                name="phoneNumber"
                label="Phone number (optional)"
                type="tel"
                autoComplete="tel"
                maxLength={32}
                defaultValue={profile.phoneNumber || ""}
              />
              <TextAreaField
                id="profile-bio"
                name="bio"
                label="A little about you (optional)"
                rows={4}
                maxLength={500}
                defaultValue={profile.bio || ""}
              />
              <PrimaryButton type="submit" disabled={saving}>
                {saving ? "Savingâ€¦" : "Save profile"}
              </PrimaryButton>
            </form>
          </Panel>

          <Panel>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Sign-in details</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">
              Current email: <span className="font-medium text-slate-800">{user.email}</span>
            </p>
            <form onSubmit={changeEmail} className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
              <label className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span className="sr-only">New email address</span>
                <input
                  name="email"
                  type="email"
                  autoComplete="email"
                  required
                  maxLength={254}
                  className="auth-input"
                  placeholder="New email address"
                />
              </label>
              <SecondaryButton type="submit" disabled={saving}>Change email</SecondaryButton>
            </form>
            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">A verified link is required to change your email.</p>
              <SecondaryButton type="button" onClick={sendPasswordReset}>Send password reset link</SecondaryButton>
            </div>
          </Panel>
        </div>

        <aside className="space-y-5">
          <Panel>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Notification preferences</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">
              Choose the updates you want to receive when notification delivery is enabled.
            </p>
            <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
              <Preference
                label="Group activity"
                description="Updates from groups you belong to"
                checked={notificationPreferences.groupActivity}
                onChange={(checked) => updatePreference("notificationPreferences", "groupActivity", checked)}
              />
              <Preference
                label="Schedule reminders"
                description="Reminders for upcoming prayer sessions"
                checked={notificationPreferences.scheduleReminders}
                onChange={(checked) => updatePreference("notificationPreferences", "scheduleReminders", checked)}
              />
              <Preference
                label="Prayer encouragement"
                description="Replies and acknowledgements on your posts"
                checked={notificationPreferences.prayerEncouragement}
                onChange={(checked) => updatePreference("notificationPreferences", "prayerEncouragement", checked)}
              />

              Push delivery requires your browser permission and the Firebase VAPID public key. Email delivery is not configured.
            </p>
            <SecondaryButton
              type="button"
              className="mt-4 w-full"
              disabled={updatingPush}
              onClick={togglePushNotifications}

              {updatingPush ? "Updatingâ€¦" : pushEnabled ? "Disable push on this device" : "Enable push on this device"}
            </SecondaryButton>

                className="auth-input"
              >
                <option value="public">Community</option>
                <option value="private">Only me</option>

                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">Places where you pray together.</p>

            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">Account deletion</h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">
              Deleting your account permanently removes your profile, avatar, private posts, comments, reports,
              and memberships. Shared prayer requests and testimonies remain but are anonymized. Group ownership
              transfers to the earliest remaining member; groups without other members are deleted. Your private
              sessions are deleted, and group sessions transfer to the new administrator and are cancelled.
            </p>
            <form onSubmit={deleteAccount} className="mt-4 space-y-3">
              <Field
                id="delete-account-password"
                name="password"
                label="Confirm your password"
                type="password"
                autoComplete="current-password"
                required
              />
              <Field
                id="delete-account-confirmation"
                name="confirmation"
                label='Type "DELETE" to confirm'
                autoComplete="off"
                required
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={deleting}
                className="rounded-xl bg-red-700 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-red-800 disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                {deleting ? "Deleting accountâ€¦" : "Permanently delete account"}
              </button>
            </form>
          </Panel>
        </aside>
      </div>

      {(error || notice) && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-24 right-4 z-40 w-[min(92vw,420px)] lg:bottom-6">
          <Notice tone={error ? "error" : "success"}>{error || notice}</Notice>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Preference({ label, description, checked, onChange }) {
  return (
    <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 p-3">
      <input
        type="checkbox"
        checked={Boolean(checked)}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.checked)}
        className="mt-1 h-4 w-4 accent-teal-800"
      />
      <span className="min-w-0">
        <span className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-800">{label}</span>
        {description && <span className="mt-0.5 block text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">{description}</span>}
      </span>
    </label>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  collection,
  collectionGroup,
  doc,
  getDoc,
  onSnapshot,
  orderBy,
  query,
  serverTimestamp,
  setDoc,
  Timestamp,
  updateDoc,
  where,
} from "firebase/firestore";
import { getFirebaseDb } from "@/lib/firebase";
import { getRecurrenceDates } from "@/lib/schedule-recurrence.mjs";
import { useCurrentUser } from "@/hooks/useCurrentUser";
import {
  EmptyState,
  Field,
  LoadingState,
  Notice,
  PageHeading,
  Panel,
  PrimaryButton,
  SelectField,
  SecondaryButton,
  TextAreaField,
  formatDate
} from "@/components/ui/DashboardPrimitives";

const db = getFirebaseDb();
const timeZone = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || "UTC";

function getDateTimeValue(timestamp) {
  if (!timestamp) return "";
  const date = timestamp.toDate();
  const local = new Date(date.getTime() - date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000);
  return local.toISOString().slice(0, 16);
}

async function respondToInvitation(session, status) {
  if (!user || !["accepted", "declined"].includes(status)) return;
  setError("");
  setNotice("");
  try {
    await updateDoc(doc(db, "prayerSchedules", session.id, "invitations", user.uid), {
      status,
      updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
    });
    setInvitationStatuses((current) => ({ ...current, [session.id]: status }));
    setNotice(status === "accepted" ? "You accepted the prayer invitation." : "You declined the prayer invitation.");
  } catch (invitationError) {
    setError(getActionError(invitationError));
  }
}

function toTimestamp(value) {
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) throw new Error("Choose a valid date and time.");
  if (date.getTime() <= Date.now()) throw new Error("Prayer sessions need to start in the future.");
  return date;
}

function getActionError(error) {
  if (error.code === "permission-denied") return "You don't have permission to change this session.";
  if (error.code === "unavailable") return "The service is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.";
  return error.message || "The change could not be saved. Please try again.";
}

export default function ScheduleWorkspace() {
  const { user, loading: authLoading } = useCurrentUser();
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState([]);
  const [groupIds, setGroupIds] = useState([]);
  const [groups, setGroups] = useState([]);
  const [attendance, setAttendance] = useState({});
  const [invitationStatuses, setInvitationStatuses] = useState({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return undefined;
    const stopOwned = onSnapshot(
      query(
        collection(db, "prayerSchedules"),
        where("creatorUid", "==", user.uid),
        orderBy("startsAt", "asc")
      ),
      (snapshot) => {
        setSessions((previous) => mergeSessions(previous, snapshot.docs));
        setLoading(false);
      },
      (snapshotError) => {
        setError(getActionError(snapshotError));
        setLoading(false);
      }
    );
    const stopMemberships = onSnapshot(
      query(collectionGroup(db, "members"), where("uid", "==", user.uid)),
      (snapshot) => {
        const memberships = snapshot.docs.map((membership) => membership.ref.parent.parent?.id).filter(Boolean);
        setGroupIds(memberships);
        if (memberships.length === 0) setGroups([]);
      },
      (snapshotError) => setError(getActionError(snapshotError))
    );
    const stopAttendance = onSnapshot(
      query(collectionGroup(db, "attendance"), where("uid", "==", user.uid)),
      (snapshot) => {
        setAttendance(
          Object.fromEntries(
            snapshot.docs.map((entry) => [entry.ref.parent.parent?.id, entry.data().status])
          )
        );
      },
      (snapshotError) => setError(getActionError(snapshotError))
    );
    let live = true;
    const stopInvitations = onSnapshot(
      query(collectionGroup(db, "invitations"), where("uid", "==", user.uid)),
      async (snapshot) => {
        try {
          const invitations = await Promise.all(snapshot.docs.map(async (invitation) => {
            const scheduleRef = invitation.ref.parent.parent;
            if (!scheduleRef) return null;
            const schedule = await getDoc(scheduleRef);
            return schedule.exists()
              ? {
                  id: schedule.id,
                  ...schedule.data(),
                  invitationStatus: invitation.data().status,
                  invitationGroupId: invitation.data().sourceGroupId
                }
              : null;
          }));
          if (!live) return;
          const validInvitations = invitations.filter(Boolean);
          setInvitationStatuses(Object.fromEntries(validInvitations.map((entry) => [entry.id, entry.invitationStatus])));
          setSessions((previous) => mergeSessions(previous, validInvitations.map((entry) => ({
            id: entry.id,
            data: () => entry
          }))));
          setLoading(false);
        } catch (invitationError) {
          setError(getActionError(invitationError));
        }
      },
      (snapshotError) => setError(getActionError(snapshotError))
    );
    return () => {
      live = false;
      stopOwned();
      stopMemberships();
      stopAttendance();
      stopInvitations();
    };
  }, [user]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user || groupIds.length === 0) return undefined;
    const stops = groupIds.map((groupId) =>
      onSnapshot(
        doc(db, "prayerGroups", groupId),
        (snapshot) => {
          if (snapshot.exists()) {
            setGroups((current) => [
              ...current.filter((group) => group.id !== groupId),
              { id: snapshot.id, ...snapshot.data() }
            ]);
          }
        },
        (snapshotError) => setError(getActionError(snapshotError))
      )
    );
    return () => stops.forEach((stop) => stop());
  }, [groupIds, user]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user || groupIds.length === 0) return undefined;
    const groupedSessions = new Map();
    const stops = groupIds.map((groupId) =>
      onSnapshot(
        query(
          collection(db, "prayerSchedules"),
          where("groupId", "==", groupId),
          orderBy("startsAt", "asc")
        ),
        (snapshot) => {
          groupedSessions.set(groupId, snapshot.docs);
          setSessions((previous) => {
            const allGroupDocs = Array.from(groupedSessions.values()).flat();
            return mergeSessions(previous.filter((session) => !session.groupId), allGroupDocs);
          });
          setLoading(false);
        },
        (snapshotError) => setError(getActionError(snapshotError))
      )
    );
    return () => stops.forEach((stop) => stop());
  }, [groupIds, user]);

  const sortedSessions = useMemo(
    () => sessions.flatMap(expandOccurrences).sort(
      (left, right) => (left.startsAt?.toMillis?.() || 0) - (right.startsAt?.toMillis?.() || 0)
    ),
    [sessions]
  );

  async function saveSession(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!user) return;
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
      const title = String(data.get("title") || "").trim();
      const description = String(data.get("description") || "").trim();
      const startsAt = toTimestamp(String(data.get("startsAt") || ""));
      const durationMinutes = Number(data.get("durationMinutes"));
      const sharingMode = String(data.get("sharingMode") || "private");
      const selectedGroupId = String(data.get("groupId") || "");
      const groupId = sharingMode === "group" ? selectedGroupId : null;
      const inviteeUids = data.getAll("inviteeUids").map(String);
      const recurrenceFrequency = String(data.get("recurrenceFrequency") || "none");
      const recurrenceCount = Number(data.get("recurrenceCount") || 1);

      if (!title || title.length > 100) throw new Error("Session titles must be between 1 and 100 characters.");
      if (!Number.isInteger(durationMinutes) || durationMinutes < 15 || durationMinutes > 240) {
        throw new Error("Choose a duration from 15 minutes to 4 hours.");
      }
      if (description.length > 1000) throw new Error("Descriptions must be 1,000 characters or fewer.");
      if (sharingMode !== "private" && !groupIds.includes(selectedGroupId)) {
        throw new Error("Choose one of your joined groups.");
      }
      if (sharingMode === "invite" && inviteeUids.length === 0) {
        throw new Error("Select at least one group member to invite.");
      }
      if (!["none", "daily", "weekly", "monthly"].includes(recurrenceFrequency)) {
        throw new Error("Choose a valid recurrence frequency.");
      }
      if (recurrenceFrequency !== "none" &&
          (!Number.isInteger(recurrenceCount) || recurrenceCount < 2 || recurrenceCount > 52)) {
        throw new Error("Recurring sessions must include between 2 and 52 occurrences.");
      }
      const recurrence = recurrenceFrequency === "none"
        ? null
        : { frequency: recurrenceFrequency, interval: 1, count: recurrenceCount };

      const values = {
        title,
        description,
        startsAt,
        durationMinutes,
        timeZone: editing?.timeZone || timeZone,
        groupId: groupId || null,
        recurrence,
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
      };
      if (editing) {
        if ((editing.groupId || "") !== (groupId || "")) {
          throw new Error("The sharing group cannot be changed while editing a session.");
        }
        await updateDoc(doc(db, "prayerSchedules", editing.id), values);
        setNotice("Your prayer session was updated.");
      } else {
        const scheduleRef = doc(collection(db, "prayerSchedules"));
        await setDoc(scheduleRef, {
          ...values,
          creatorUid: user.uid,
          cancelled: false,
          createdAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
        if (sharingMode === "invite") {
          try {
            const response = await fetch(`/api/schedules/${scheduleRef.id}/invitations`, {
              method: "POST",
              headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
              body: JSON.stringify({ sourceGroupId: selectedGroupId, uids: inviteeUids })
            });
            const result = await response.json();
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || "Unable to send invitations.");
          } catch (invitationError) {
            await updateDoc(scheduleRef, {
              cancelled: true,
              updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
            });
            throw new Error(`The session was saved as cancelled because invitations could not be sent: ${invitationError.message}`);
          }
        }
        setNotice("Your prayer session is scheduled.");
      }
      setEditing(null);
      setShowForm(false);
    } catch (saveError) {
      setError(getActionError(saveError));
    }
  }

  async function cancelSession(session) {
    if (!window.confirm(`Cancel "${session.title}"? Group members will see it as cancelled.`)) return;
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      await updateDoc(doc(db, "prayerSchedules", session.id), {
        cancelled: true,
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
      setNotice("The session was cancelled.");
    } catch (cancelError) {
      setError(getActionError(cancelError));
    }
  }

  async function respond(session, status) {
    if (!user || (!session.groupId && invitationStatuses[session.id] !== "accepted")) return;
    setError("");
    setNotice("");
    try {
      await setDoc(doc(db, "prayerSchedules", session.id, "attendance", user.uid), {
        uid: user.uid,
        status,
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
      setNotice(status === "attending" ? "You're marked as attending." : "Your response was updated.");
    } catch (respondError) {
      setError(getActionError(respondError));
    }
  }

  if (authLoading || loading) return <LoadingState label="Loading your scheduleâ€¦" />;
  if (!user) return <Notice>Please sign in again to open your schedule.</Notice>;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeading
        eyebrow="Make time to pray"
        title="Prayer schedule"
        description="Plan a session with your group and keep the time that matters."
        action={
          <PrimaryButton
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setEditing(null);
              setShowForm((value) => !value);
            }}
          >
            {showForm ? "Close form" : "Schedule prayer"}
          </PrimaryButton>
        }
      />

      <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_300px]">
        <div className="space-y-5">
          {showForm && (
            <SessionForm
              key={editing?.id || "new-session"}
              editing={editing}
              groups={groups}
              user={user}
              onError={setError}
              onSave={saveSession}
              onCancel={() => {
                setEditing(null);
                setShowForm(false);
              }}
              error={error}
            />
          )}

          {sortedSessions.length === 0 ? (
            <Panel>
              <EmptyState
                title="A little time set aside can mean a lot"
                description="Create a prayer session, or join a group to see its shared schedule here."
              >
                  <PrimaryButton type="button" onClick={() => setShowForm(true)}>
                    Schedule your first prayer
                  </PrimaryButton>
              </EmptyState>
            </Panel>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {sortedSessions.map((session) => {
                const isCreator = session.creatorUid === user.uid;
                const status = attendance[session.id];
                const invitationStatus = invitationStatuses[session.id];
                return (
                <Panel key={`${session.id}:${session.occurrenceIndex || 0}`} className={session.cancelled ? "opacity-65" : ""}>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{session.title}</h2>
                          {session.cancelled && (
                            <span className="rounded-full bg-red-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-red-700">
                              Cancelled
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {isCreator && (
                            <span className="rounded-full bg-teal-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-teal-800">
                              Your session
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {session.occurrenceIndex > 0 && (
                            <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                              Repeat {session.occurrenceIndex + 1}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
                          {formatDate(session.startsAt)} Â· {session.durationMinutes} minutes
                        </p>
                        {session.description && (
                          <p className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">
                            {session.description}
                          </p>
                        )}
                        <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">
                          {session.groupId
                            ? `Shared with ${groups.find((group) => group.id === session.groupId)?.name || "your prayer group"} Â· ${session.timeZone || "local time"}`
                            : invitationStatus
                              ? `Invitation Â· ${groups.find((group) => group.id === session.invitationGroupId)?.name || "your prayer group"} Â· ${session.timeZone || "local time"}`
                              : `Private Â· ${session.timeZone || "local time"}`}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        {(session.groupId || invitationStatus === "accepted") && !isCreator && !session.cancelled && (
                          <SecondaryButton
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => respond(session, status === "attending" ? "declined" : "attending")}
                          >
                            {status === "attending" ? "Attending âœ“" : "Iâ€™ll attend"}
                          </SecondaryButton>
                        )}
                        {invitationStatus === "pending" && !isCreator && !session.cancelled && (
                          <>
                            <SecondaryButton type="button" onClick={() => respondToInvitation(session, "accepted")}>
                              Accept invitation
                            </SecondaryButton>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => respondToInvitation(session, "declined")}
                              className="rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100"
                            >
                              Decline
                            </button>
                          </>
                        )}
                        {invitationStatus === "accepted" && !isCreator && (
                          <span className="self-center text-xs font-medium text-teal-800">Invitation accepted</span>
                        )}
                        {isCreator && !session.cancelled && (session.occurrenceIndex || 0) === 0 && (
                          <>
                            <SecondaryButton
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setEditing(sessions.find((entry) => entry.id === session.id) || session);
                                setShowForm(true);
                                setError("");
                              }}
                            >
                              Edit
                            </SecondaryButton>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => cancelSession(session)}
                              className="rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50"
                            >
                              Cancel
                            </button>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Panel>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <aside className="space-y-5">
          <Panel>

    </div>

}

function mergeSessions(previous, snapshotDocs) {
  const merged = new Map(previous.map((session) => [session.id, session]));
  snapshotDocs.forEach((sessionDoc) => {
    merged.set(sessionDoc.id, { id: sessionDoc.id, ...sessionDoc.data() });
  });
  return Array.from(merged.values());
}

function expandOccurrences(session) {
  const recurrence = session.recurrence;
  if (!recurrence?.frequency || !recurrence.count || recurrence.count < 2) return [session];

  return getRecurrenceDates(
    session.startsAt.toDate(),
    recurrence,
    session.timeZone || timeZone
  ).map((occurrence, occurrenceIndex) => ({
    ...session,
    startsAt: Timestamp.fromDate(occurrence),
    occurrenceIndex
  }));
}

function SessionForm({ editing, groups, user, onSave, onCancel, onError, error }) {
  const [sharingMode, setSharingMode] = useState(editing?.groupId ? "group" : "private");
  const [selectedGroupId, setSelectedGroupId] = useState(editing?.groupId || "");
  const [members, setMembers] = useState([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sharingMode !== "invite" || !selectedGroupId) return undefined;
    return onSnapshot(
      collection(db, "prayerGroups", selectedGroupId, "members"),
      (snapshot) => setMembers(snapshot.docs.map((member) => member.data()).filter((member) => member.uid !== user.uid)),
      (snapshotError) => onError(getActionError(snapshotError))
    );
  }, [onError, selectedGroupId, sharingMode, user.uid]);

  return (
    <Panel>
      <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{editing ? "Edit prayer session" : "Create a prayer session"}</h2>
      <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">
        {editing ? "Update the details for your session." : "Choose a time and, if you like, share it with one of your groups."}
      </p>
      <form onSubmit={onSave} className="mt-5 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Field
          id="session-title"
          name="title"
          label="Session title"
          required
          maxLength={100}
          defaultValue={editing?.title || ""}
          className="sm:col-span-2"
        />
        <TextAreaField
          id="session-description"
          name="description"
          label="Description (optional)"
          maxLength={1000}
          rows={3}
          defaultValue={editing?.description || ""}
          className="sm:col-span-2"
        />
        <Field
          id="session-start"
          name="startsAt"
          type="datetime-local"
          label="Starts at"
          required
          defaultValue={getDateTimeValue(editing?.startsAt)}
        />
        <SelectField
          id="session-duration"
          name="durationMinutes"
          label="Duration"
          defaultValue={String(editing?.durationMinutes || 30)}
        >
          {[15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 180, 240].map((duration) => (
            <option key={duration} value={duration}>
              {duration < 60 ? `${duration} minutes` : `${duration / 60} hour${duration === 60 ? "" : "s"}`}
            </option>
          ))}
        </SelectField>
        <SelectField
          id="session-sharing"
          name="sharingMode"
          label="Who can access it?"
          value={sharingMode}
          onChange={(event) => setSharingMode(event.target.value)}
        >
          <option value="private">Only me</option>
          <option value="group" disabled={groups.length === 0}>Share with a whole group</option>
          <option value="invite" disabled={groups.length === 0 || Boolean(editing?.groupId)}>Invite selected group members</option>
        </SelectField>
        {sharingMode !== "private" && (
          <SelectField
            id="session-group"
            name="groupId"
            label={sharingMode === "group" ? "Share with group" : "Choose invitees from"}
            value={selectedGroupId}
            onChange={(event) => setSelectedGroupId(event.target.value)}
            required
          >
            <option value="">Choose a group</option>
            {groups.map((group) => <option key={group.id} value={group.id}>{group.name}</option>)}
          </SelectField>
        )}
        {sharingMode === "invite" && selectedGroupId && (
          <fieldset className="space-y-2 sm:col-span-2">
            <legend className="mb-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-800">Select people to invite</legend>
            {members.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">This group has no other members to invite.</p>
            ) : members.map((member) => (
              <label key={member.uid} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm">
                <input type="checkbox" name="inviteeUids" value={member.uid} className="accent-teal-800" />
                <span>{member.displayName || "Group member"}</span>
              </label>
            ))}
          </fieldset>
        )}
        <SelectField
          id="session-recurrence"
          name="recurrenceFrequency"
          label="Repeat"
          defaultValue={editing?.recurrence?.frequency || "none"}
        >
          <option value="none">Does not repeat</option>
          <option value="daily">Every day</option>
          <option value="weekly">Every week</option>
          <option value="monthly">Every month</option>
        </SelectField>
        <Field
          id="session-recurrence-count"
          name="recurrenceCount"
          type="number"
          label="Occurrences, including the first"
          min={2}
          max={52}
          defaultValue={editing?.recurrence?.count || 4}
        />
        {error && <div className="sm:col-span-2"><Notice>{error}</Notice></div>}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 sm:col-span-2">
          <PrimaryButton type="submit">{editing ? "Save changes" : "Schedule session"}</PrimaryButton>
          <SecondaryButton type="button" onClick={onCancel}>Cancel</SecondaryButton>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Panel>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "firebase/auth";
import { getFirebaseAuth } from "@/lib/firebase";

export function useCurrentUser() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    return onAuthStateChanged(getFirebaseAuth(), (currentUser) => {
      setUser(currentUser);
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, []);

  return { user, loading };
}

import "server-only";

import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { getFirebaseAdminAuth } from "./firebase-admin";

export const SESSION_COOKIE_NAME = "__session";

const INVALID_SESSION_CODES = new Set([
  "auth/argument-error",
  "auth/id-token-revoked",
  "auth/invalid-session-cookie",
  "auth/session-cookie-expired",
  "auth/session-cookie-revoked",
  "auth/user-disabled"
]);

export async function getSessionUser() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const sessionCookie = cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value;

  if (!sessionCookie) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return await getFirebaseAdminAuth().verifySessionCookie(sessionCookie, true);
  } catch (error) {
    if (INVALID_SESSION_CODES.has(error.code)) {
      return null;
    }

    throw error;
  }
}

import { getApps, initializeApp } from "firebase/app";
import { getAuth } from "firebase/auth";
import { getFirestore } from "firebase/firestore";
import { getStorage } from "firebase/storage";

const firebaseConfig = {
  apiKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY,
  authDomain: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN,
  projectId: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID,
  storageBucket: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET,
  messagingSenderId: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID,
  appId: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID
};

const requiredKeys = ["apiKey", "authDomain", "projectId", "appId"];
const missingKeys = requiredKeys.filter((key) => !firebaseConfig[key]);

if (missingKeys.length > 0) {
  throw new Error(
    `Firebase client configuration is missing: ${missingKeys.join(", ")}. ` +
      "Set the corresponding NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* values in .env.local."
  );
}

const existingApp = getApps().find((firebaseApp) => firebaseApp.name === "[DEFAULT]");
const app = existingApp || initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
const auth = getAuth(app);
const db = getFirestore(app, "default");
const storage = getStorage(app);
storage.maxUploadRetryTime = 60_000;

export { app, auth, db, storage };
export default app;

export function getFirebaseAuth() {
  return auth;
}

export function getFirebaseDb() {
  return db;
}

import "server-only";

import { applicationDefault, cert, getApps, initializeApp } from "firebase-admin/app";
import { getAuth } from "firebase-admin/auth";
import { getFirestore } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
import { getStorage } from "firebase-admin/storage";

function getFirebaseAdminApp() {
  const defaultApp = getApps().find((app) => app.name === "[DEFAULT]");

  if (defaultApp) {
    return defaultApp;
  }

  const projectId =
    process.env.FIREBASE_ADMIN_PROJECT_ID || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID;
  const clientEmail = process.env.FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL;
  const privateKey = process.env.FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY?.replace(/\\n/g, "\n");

  if (!projectId) {
    throw new Error(
      "Firebase Admin configuration is missing. Set FIREBASE_ADMIN_PROJECT_ID or " +
        "NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID and provide service credentials or Application Default Credentials."
    );
  }

  if (!clientEmail && !privateKey && !process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS) {
    throw new Error(
      "Firebase Admin credentials are not configured. Set FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL and " +
        "FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY, or configure GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS."
    );
  }

  if (Boolean(clientEmail) !== Boolean(privateKey)) {
    throw new Error(
      "Firebase Admin service account configuration is incomplete. Set both " +
        "FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL and FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY, or configure Application Default Credentials."
    );
  }

  const credential =
    clientEmail && privateKey
      ? cert({ projectId, clientEmail, privateKey })
      : applicationDefault();

  return initializeApp({ credential, projectId });
}

export function getFirebaseAdminAuth() {
  return getAuth(getFirebaseAdminApp());
}

export function getFirebaseAdminDb() {
  return getFirestore(getFirebaseAdminApp(), "default");
}

export function getFirebaseAdminStorage() {
  return getStorage(getFirebaseAdminApp());
}

FILE: src\lib\schedule-recurrence.mjs

export function getRecurrenceDates(startDate, recurrence, timeZone) {
  if (
    !recurrence ||
    !["daily", "weekly", "monthly"].includes(recurrence.frequency) ||
    !Number.isInteger(recurrence.count) ||
    recurrence.count < 2 ||
    recurrence.count > 52
  ) {
    return [new Date(startDate)];
  }

  const start = getZonedParts(new Date(startDate), timeZone);
  return Array.from({ length: recurrence.count }, (_, index) => {
    if (index === 0) return new Date(startDate);
    const calendarDate = getOccurrenceDate(
      start,
      recurrence.frequency,
      recurrence.interval || 1,
      index
    );
    return zonedDateToUtc({
      ...calendarDate,
      hour: start.hour,
      minute: start.minute,
      second: start.second
    }, timeZone);
  });
}

function getOccurrenceDate(start, frequency, interval, index) {
  if (frequency === "monthly") {
    const monthIndex = start.month - 1 + index * interval;
    const year = start.year + Math.floor(monthIndex / 12);
    const month = (monthIndex % 12) + 1;
    const lastDay = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).getUTCDate();
    return { year, month, day: Math.min(start.day, lastDay) };
  }

  const dayOffset = index * interval * (frequency === "weekly" ? 7 : 1);
  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(start.year, start.month - 1, start.day + dayOffset));
  return {
    year: date.getUTCFullYear(),
    month: date.getUTCMonth() + 1,
    day: date.getUTCDate()
  };
}

function getZonedParts(date, timeZone) {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
    timeZone,
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    second: "2-digit",
    hourCycle: "h23"
  }).formatToParts(date);
  return Object.fromEntries(parts.map((part) => [part.type, Number(part.value)]));
}

function zonedDateToUtc(target, timeZone) {
  const targetTime = Date.UTC(
    target.year,
    target.month - 1,
    target.day,
    target.hour,
    target.minute,
    target.second
  );
  let candidate = targetTime;
  let previous = null;

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 6; attempt += 1) {
    const actual = getZonedParts(new Date(candidate), timeZone);
    const actualTime = Date.UTC(
      actual.year,
      actual.month - 1,
      actual.day,
      actual.hour,
      actual.minute,
      actual.second
    );
    const adjusted = candidate + targetTime - actualTime;
    if (adjusted === candidate) return new Date(candidate);
    if (adjusted === previous) return new Date(Math.max(candidate, adjusted));
    previous = candidate;
    candidate = adjusted;
  }
  return new Date(candidate);
}

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { getRecurrenceDates } from "./schedule-recurrence.mjs";

function localParts(date, timeZone) {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
      timeZone,
      year: "numeric",
      month: "2-digit",
      day: "2-digit",
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
      hourCycle: "h23"
    })
      .formatToParts(date)
      .map((part) => [part.type, part.value])
  );
}

test("weekly recurrences preserve local wall time across daylight-saving transitions", () => {
  const dates = getRecurrenceDates(
    new Date("2027-03-07T14:00:00.000Z"),
    { frequency: "weekly", interval: 1, count: 3 },
    "America/New_York"
  );
  assert.deepEqual(dates.map((date) => localParts(date, "America/New_York").hour), ["09", "09", "09"]);
  assert.equal((dates[1] - dates[0]) / 3_600_000, 167);
  assert.equal((dates[2] - dates[1]) / 3_600_000, 168);
});

test("monthly recurrences clamp to the last calendar day of shorter months", () => {
  const dates = getRecurrenceDates(
    new Date("2027-01-31T09:00:00.000Z"),
    { frequency: "monthly", interval: 1, count: 3 },
    "UTC"
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    dates.map((date) => `${date.getUTCFullYear()}-${date.getUTCMonth() + 1}-${date.getUTCDate()}`),
    ["2027-1-31", "2027-2-28", "2027-3-31"]
  );
});

test("a local time skipped by spring daylight-saving moves forward to the next valid time", () => {
  const dates = getRecurrenceDates(
    new Date("2027-02-14T07:30:00.000Z"),
    { frequency: "monthly", interval: 1, count: 2 },
    "America/New_York"
  );
  const march = localParts(dates[1], "America/New_York");
  assert.equal(march.month, "03");
  assert.equal(march.day, "14");
  assert.equal(march.hour, "03");
  assert.equal(march.minute, "30");
});
